jobs.description:
Unser Customer Competence Center fasst für unsere Immobilieneigentümer eine Vielzahl an betriebswirtschaftlichen Tätigkeiten zusammen. Ziel ist es, unseren Eigentümerkunden einen qualitativen Rundumservice effizient zur Verfügung zu stellen.

Du hast bereits fundierte Buchhaltungskenntnisse, bevorzugt im Immobilienbereich gesammelt? Du arbeitest gerne hybrid in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit modernen Arbeitsformen und Methoden? Möchtest du mit uns die Übernahme weiterer buchhalterischer Aufgaben in unserem Team aktiv vorantreiben? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung als

Immobilienbuchhalter (m/w/d)

Olten oder Bern, 60%

Das bewegst du:

• Du betreust eigenständig ein Portfolio mit speziellen Liegenschaften, erledigst Aufträge unserer internen Kunden termingerecht und sicherst dabei eine hohe Qualität

• In der Immobilienbuchhaltung bist du zuständig für die Monats-, Quartals- sowie Jahresabschlüsse, tätigst diverse Korrektur- sowie Umbuchungen und dir obliegt die Kontierung und die Verbuchung von Kreditorenrechnungen

• Die Pflege und Aktualisierung von Stammdaten, die Bearbeitung von Mandatszu- und -abgängen sowie die Abwicklung des Finanzverkehrs gehören zu Deinem Arbeitsalltag

• Du pflegst den buchhalterischen Kontakt zu unseren Kunden, führst Eigentümerbankkonten und stellst die Liquiditätsplanung sicher

• Bestehende Prozesse analysierst Du laufend, entwickelst Optimierungsvorschläge und behältst offene Arbeiten sowie Pendenzen jederzeit im Blick

Deshalb gelingt es dir:

• Du verfügst über eine kaufmännische Grundausbildung und fundierte Buchhaltungskenntnisse in der Immobilienbranche

• Dein buchhalterisches Fachwissen hast du vorzugsweise mit einer relevanten Weiterbildung vertieft, bspw. als Sachbearbeiter Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder in der Immobilienbewirtschaftung

• Mit deiner flexiblen und exakten Arbeitsweise arbeitest du selbständig an deinen Aufgaben

• Du hast eine rasche Auffassungsgabe und punktest mit deinem analytischen Denkvermögen

• Du bist dienstleistungsorientiert, kontaktfreudig und aufgeschlossen und dir gelingt der konstruktive Dialog mit deinen Partnern in der Bewirtschaftung und im Center Management

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch, Französisch ist von Vorteil

Hier einige unserer Benefits:

• Arbeitszeiten: Wir leben mobiles Arbeiten mit individueller (Jahres)-Arbeitszeit und/oder Teilzeitarbeit. Bis zu 40% Home-Office sind möglich. Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns grossgeschrieben, denn ausgeglichene und erholte Mitarbeitende sind uns wichtig. Der Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferien ist möglich.

• Mobilität und Verpflegung: Du erhältst einen Beitrag für das Mobiltelefon. Für deine Verpflegung leisten wir ebenfalls einen Beitrag.

• Aus- und Weiterbildung: Das Fördern von Mitarbeitenden ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil unserer Kultur. Profitiere von einer grosszügigen Unterstützung bei internen und externen Aus- und Weiterbildungen. Wir bieten Laufbahnmöglichkeiten in Führungs-, Fach- und Projektfunktionen

• Salär: Bei uns erwartet dich eine marktgerechte Entlöhnung mit absoluter Lohngleichheit für alle Geschlechter. Die Pensionskassenleistungen sind attraktiv und du kannst aus verschiedenen Modellen das für dich passende wählen. Die Unfallschutzversicherung deckt die private Spitalabteilung ab.

Weitere Informationen zu unseren Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

#Wincasa

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il nostro Customer Competence Center combina un gran numero di attività commerciali per i nostri proprietari. L'obiettivo è quello di fornire ai nostri clienti proprietari un efficiente servizio di qualità a tutto tondo.

Hai già acquisito una solida conoscenza contabile, preferibilmente nel settore immobiliare? Ti piace lavorare ibrido in un ambiente dinamico con forme moderne di lavoro e metodi? Vorresti promuovere attivamente l'assunzione di ulteriori compiti contabili nel nostro team con noi? Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione come

Immobili commerciali (m/f/d)

Olten o Berna, 60%

Questo è ciò che ti muove:

• Gestisci in modo indipendente un portafoglio con proprietà speciali, ordini completi dei nostri clienti interni nel tempo e assicurati un'alta qualità

• Nella contabilità immobiliare, si è responsabili per i conti mensili, trimestrali e annuali, effettuare varie correzioni e rebookings e si è responsabili per la contabilità e la prenotazione delle fatture dei creditori.

• Mantenere e aggiornare i dati master, elaborare mandati in entrata e in uscita e gestire transazioni finanziarie fanno parte del vostro lavoro quotidiano

• Si mantiene il contatto contabile con i nostri clienti, mantenere i conti bancari del proprietario e garantire la pianificazione liquidità

• Analizzare i processi esistenti Si sta costantemente sviluppando suggerimenti di ottimizzazione e tenere d'occhio il lavoro aperto e pendencies in ogni momento

Ecco perché hai successo:

• Hai una formazione commerciale di base e una solida conoscenza contabile nel settore immobiliare

• Hai preferibilmente approfondito la tua esperienza contabile con una formazione ulteriore rilevante, ad esempio come specialista in finanza e contabilità o nella gestione immobiliare.

• Con il tuo metodo di lavoro flessibile e preciso, lavori in modo indipendente sui tuoi compiti

• Hai una rapida comprensione e punteggio con la tua capacità di pensiero analitico

• Siete orientati al servizio, socievoli e open-minded e avete successo nel dialogo costruttivo con i vostri partner nella gestione e nella gestione del centro

• Hai competenze linguistiche molto buone in tedesco, il francese è un vantaggio

Ecco alcuni dei nostri vantaggi:

• Ore lavorative: Viviamo il lavoro mobile con ore di lavoro individuali (anno) e/o lavoro part-time. Fino al 40% home office è possibile. L'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una priorità assoluta per noi, perché i dipendenti equilibrati e rilassati sono importanti per noi. L'acquisto di vacanze aggiuntive è possibile.

• Mobilità e cibo: riceverete un contributo per il telefono cellulare. Per il vostro cibo, offriamo anche un contributo.

• Istruzione e formazione: promuovere i dipendenti è una parte importante della nostra cultura. Approfittate del generoso sostegno all'istruzione e alla formazione interna ed esterna. Offriamo opportunità di carriera nelle funzioni gestionali, specialistiche e di progetto

• Salär: Con noi puoi aspettarti una remunerazione basata sul mercato con una retribuzione assoluta pari a tutti i generi. I benefici pensione sono attraenti e si può scegliere quello giusto per voi da modelli diversi. L'assicurazione contro gli infortuni copre il dipartimento ospedaliero privato.

Ulteriori informazioni sui nostri vantaggi possono essere trovate nella nostra pagina di carriera.

♪Wincasa
descriptionByLocale.en:
Our Customer Competence Center combines a large number of business activities for our property owners. The aim is to provide our owner customers with an efficient all-round quality service.

You have already gained sound accounting knowledge, preferably in the real estate sector? Do you like to work hybrid in a dynamic environment with modern forms of work and methods? Would you like to actively promote the assumption of further accounting tasks in our team with us? We look forward to your application as

Real estate accountants (m/f/d)

Olten or Bern, 60 %

This is what moves you:

• You independently manage a portfolio with special properties, complete orders of our internal customers on time and ensure a high quality

• In real estate accounting, you are responsible for the monthly, quarterly and annual accounts, make various corrections and rebookings and you are responsible for the accounting and booking of creditors' invoices.

• Maintaining and updating master data, processing incoming and outgoing mandates and handling financial transactions are part of your everyday work

• You maintain accounting contact with our customers, maintain owner bank accounts and ensure liquidity planning

• Analyze existing processes You are constantly developing optimization suggestions and keep an eye on open work and pendencies at all times

This is why you succeed:

• You have a basic commercial education and sound accounting knowledge in the real estate industry

• You have preferably deepened your accounting expertise with relevant further training, for example as a specialist in finance and accounting or in real estate management.

• With your flexible and exact working method, you work independently on your tasks

• You have a quick apprehension and score with your analytical thinking ability

• You are service-oriented, sociable and open-minded and you succeed in constructive dialogue with your partners in management and center management

• You have very good language skills in German, French is an advantage

Here are some of our benefits:

• Working hours: We live mobile work with individual (year) working hours and/or part-time work. Up to 40% home office is possible. Work-life balance is a top priority for us, because balanced and relaxed employees are important to us. The purchase of additional holidays is possible.

• Mobility and food: You will receive a contribution for the mobile phone. For your food, we also make a contribution.

• Education and training: Promoting employees is an important part of our culture. Benefit from generous support in internal and external education and training. We offer career opportunities in management, specialist and project functions

• Salär: With us you can expect a market-based remuneration with absolute equal pay for all genders. The pension benefits are attractive and you can choose the right one for you from different models. The accident protection insurance covers the private hospital department.

More information about our benefits can be found on our career page.

#Wincasa

Comptables immobiliers (h/f/d)

Olten ou Berne, 60 %

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nella nostra posizione "Vivere" a Zug, gli inquilini non solo si sentono a casa, ma sono anche serviti in modo ottimale ed efficiente dalla nostra nuova assegnazione di compiti nella squadra. Questo non solo ha vantaggi per gli inquilini e la proprietà, ma anche per voi. Attraverso una maggiore specializzazione nella squadra, lavoriamo più strettamente insieme, e tutti possono concentrarsi sui loro punti di forza.

Se il vostro cuore batte per l'immobiliare, siete motivati, orientati verso l'obiettivo e anche come lavorare in una squadra, allora non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione come

Responsabile della proprietà (m/f/d)

Treno, 70-100 %

Questo è ciò che ti muove:

• Sei responsabile del supporto del team in tutte le attività amministrative all'interno del sito per garantire un funzionamento regolare

• Come primo punto di contatto sul sito, si prende il controllo del supporto clienti e sono responsabili del primo contatto con i clienti e gli inquilini

• Comunicare con l'inquilino, la manutenzione domestica, le imprese artigianali e gli uffici è uno dei vostri compiti per garantire uno scambio efficace di informazioni.

• L'utente è responsabile dell'esecuzione delle dichiarazioni finali e degli insediamenti custodi, nonché dell'ottenimento e della valutazione delle offerte, dell'attribuzione di contratti alle imprese artigianali e del monitoraggio del lavoro

• La contabilità, il trattamento e l'inoltro degli ordini e delle fatture creditori, nonché il controllo del debitore e il trattamento del sistema di annullamento rientrano anche nella vostra area di responsabilità.

Ecco perché hai successo:

• Hai completato la formazione commerciale di base e preferibilmente l'ufficio di gestione della proprietà o la volontà di completare questa ulteriore formazione

• Prima esperienza professionale come impiegato: in (vantaggio nel settore immobiliare o simile) si potrebbe già raccogliere

• Siete capaci di squadra, resilienti e distinti dalla vostra personalità orientata al cliente e al servizio

• Un metodo di lavoro indipendente e orientato agli obiettivi e buone capacità di comunicazione si qualificano nel trattare con diversi gruppi di persone

• Comunichi verbalmente e per iscritto fluentemente in tedesco

Ecco alcuni dei nostri vantaggi:

• Ore lavorative: Viviamo il lavoro mobile con ore di lavoro individuali (anno) e/o lavoro part-time. Fino al 40% home office è possibile. L'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una priorità assoluta per noi, perché i dipendenti equilibrati e rilassati sono importanti per noi. L'acquisto di vacanze aggiuntive è possibile.

• Mobilità e cibo: riceverete un contributo per il telefono cellulare. Per il vostro cibo, offriamo anche un contributo.

• Istruzione e formazione: promuovere i dipendenti è una parte importante della nostra cultura. Approfittate del generoso sostegno all'istruzione e alla formazione interna ed esterna. Offriamo opportunità di carriera nelle funzioni gestionali, specialistiche e di progetto

• Salär: Con noi puoi aspettarti una remunerazione basata sul mercato con una retribuzione assoluta pari a tutti i generi. I benefici pensione sono attraenti e si può scegliere quello giusto per voi da modelli diversi. L'assicurazione contro gli infortuni copre il dipartimento ospedaliero privato.

Ulteriori informazioni sui nostri vantaggi possono essere trovate nella nostra pagina di carriera.

♪Wincasa
descriptionByLocale.en:
At our "Living" location in Zug, tenants not only feel at home, but are also served optimally and efficiently by our new allocation of tasks in the team. This not only has advantages for tenants and ownership, but also for you. Through more specialization in the team, we work more closely together, and everyone can focus on their strengths.

If your heart beats for real estate, you are motivated, goal-oriented and also like to work in a team, then we look forward to your application as

Property Manager (m/f/d)

Train, 70-100 %

This is what moves you:

• You are responsible for supporting the team in all administrative activities within the site to ensure a smooth operation

• As the first point of contact on site, you take over the customer support and are responsible for the first contact with customers and tenants

• Communicating with the tenant, home maintenance, craft businesses and offices is one of your tasks to ensure an effective exchange of information.

• You are responsible for carrying out final statements and custodial settlements as well as for obtaining and assessing offers, awarding contracts to craft businesses and monitoring the work

• The accounting, processing and forwarding of creditor orders and invoices as well as the debtor control and processing of the dunning system also fall within your area of responsibility.

This is why you succeed:

• You have completed basic commercial training and preferably the property management clerk or the willingness to complete this further training

• First professional experience as a clerk: in (advantage in the real estate industry or similar) you could already collect

• You are team-capable, resilient and distinguished by your customer- and service-oriented personality

• An independent and goal-oriented working method as well as good communication skills qualify you in dealing with different groups of people

• You communicate verbally and in writing fluently in German

Here are some of our benefits:

• Working hours: We live mobile work with individual (year) working hours and/or part-time work. Up to 40% home office is possible. Work-life balance is a top priority for us, because balanced and relaxed employees are important to us. The purchase of additional holidays is possible.

• Mobility and food: You will receive a contribution for the mobile phone. For your food, we also make a contribution.

• Education and training: Promoting employees is an important part of our culture. Benefit from generous support in internal and external education and training. We offer career opportunities in management, specialist and project functions

• Salär: With us you can expect a market-based remuneration with absolute equal pay for all genders. The pension benefits are attractive and you can choose the right one for you from different models. The accident protection insurance covers the private hospital department.

More information about our benefits can be found on our career page.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
À notre emplacement à Olten, qui se concentre sur l'immobilier commercial, nous répondons aux besoins individuels et complexes de nos clients avec une expertise spécialisée et une expertise de négociation. En tant que partenaire au niveau des yeux, nous nous concentrons en particulier sur les propriétés de bureaux et commerciales dans le bassin versant régional. Avec des stratégies de marketing ciblées et sur mesure, nous poursuivons l'ambition de louer avec succès n'importe quel secteur tout en établissant des relations durables et à long terme avec les propriétaires et les locataires commerciaux.

Si votre cœur bat pour l'immobilier, vous apportez une mentalité de fabricant et aussi aiment travailler dans une équipe, alors nous attendons avec impatience votre application comme

Senior manager immobilier commercial (gestion de site STV) (h/f/d)

Olten, 80-100 %

C'est ce qui vous pousse:

• En tant que gestionnaire adjoint de l'emplacement (lieu Alten et Zug), vous êtes responsable de la gestion professionnelle des employés à votre emplacement. Vous recrutez, autonomisez et développez vos employés

• En outre, vous assurez un flux de communication parfait, la conformité avec les processus et les spécifications ainsi que la gestion des performances

• En tant que modèle et grâce à la promotion et au contrôle actifs, vous assurez la qualité du service à votre emplacement

• Vous êtes responsable de la gestion globale d'un portefeuille de propriétés commerciales, y compris la location, le contrat et la gestion des clés et d'assurer la bonne condition

• Grâce à votre expertise et vos compétences en négociation, vous dirigez des négociations réussies et créez des baux d'affaires ainsi que des suppléments

• La communication avec le propriétaire, le locataire, les autorités et d'autres intervenants ainsi que l'organisation des réunions et l'orientation du locataire sont de votre responsabilité.

• Vous êtes responsable de l'obtention et de l'évaluation des offres, de l'attribution des contrats aux entreprises et du contrôle et de la libération des ordres et factures des créanciers

• En tant que point de contact professionnel dans l'équipe, vous êtes responsable de la formation et de l'orientation des employés

• La préparation du budget annuel relève également de votre domaine de responsabilité.

C'est pourquoi vous réussissez:

• Vous avez une éducation commerciale de base, vous êtes un gestionnaire immobilier avec un certificat professionnel fédéral et idéalement en possession du diplôme en tant que syndic immobilier

• Vous avez également plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans la gestion de propriétés commerciales

• Coaching, motivation et travail pragmatique comptent parmi vos forces

• Il est facile pour vous de construire, maintenir et développer la confiance avec différents steakholders internes et externes.

• L'affinité numérique et la connaissance approfondie du PC et du logiciel sont habilement utilisées quotidiennement dans le travail avec différents systèmes

• Une méthode de travail efficace et orientée vers l'objectif ainsi que de bonnes compétences en communication avec des compétences en négociation vous qualifient pour traiter avec différents groupes cibles exigeants

• Un service élevé et l'orientation client sont une question bien sûr pour vous

• Les bonnes manières, la capacité de charge élevée ainsi que la flexibilité et l'endurance complètent votre profil

• Vous communiquez verbalement et par écrit couramment en allemand

Voici quelques-uns de nos avantages:

• Heures de travail: Nous vivons un travail mobile avec des heures de travail individuelles (année) et/ou à temps partiel. Jusqu'à 40% de bureau à domicile est possible. L'équilibre entre le travail et la vie personnelle est une priorité pour nous, car les employés équilibrés et détendus sont importants pour nous. L'achat de jours fériés supplémentaires est possible.

• Mobilité et nourriture: Vous recevrez une contribution pour le téléphone mobile. Pour votre nourriture, nous apportons également une contribution. commutation = temps de travail, si le travail en déplacement est considéré comme du temps de travail

• Éducation et formation: La promotion des employés est un élément important de notre culture. Bénéficiez d'un soutien généreux dans l'éducation et la formation internes et externes. Nous offrons des opportunités de carrière en gestion, spécialiste et fonctions de projet

• Salär: Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à une rémunération basée sur le marché avec un salaire absolu égal pour tous les sexes. Les prestations de retraite sont attrayantes et vous pouvez choisir la bonne pour vous parmi différents modèles. L'assurance contre les accidents couvre le service hospitalier privé.

Plus d'informations sur nos avantages se trouvent sur notre page carrière.

Con temi quali la qualità e l'istruzione, la gestione delle conoscenze, la reporting e analisi e la gestione delle forze di lavoro, il dipartimento di supporto aziendale garantisce un controllo efficiente del centro di contatto e sviluppa continuamente processi e sistemi.

Per completare il nostro team esistente a Winterthur, stiamo cercando una personalità esperta e orientata al cliente per accordo come

Gestione delle forze di lavoro (m/f/d)

Winterthur, 80-100 %

Questo è ciò che ti muove:

• Si assume responsabilità professionale per la gestione della forza lavoro, coordina i dipendenti che lavorano nella zona e sviluppa continuamente processi, standard e meccanismi di controllo

• Sulla base di previsioni, analisi e scenari di domanda, si ricavano le risorse, capacità, competenze e requisiti linguistici tenendo conto degli obiettivi di restringimento e servizio e garantire la pianificazione predittiva

• Siete responsabili della pianificazione del personale, del calcolo e del controllo delle quote di vacanza e di assenza tenendo conto delle capacità, dei modelli di tempo di lavoro, delle competenze, delle lingue e degli obiettivi di servizio.

• Sei responsabile del controllo operativo intraday, monitora volumi, capacità e livelli di servizio in tempo reale e avvia misure mirate per garantire obiettivi di servizio e produttività in caso di deviazioni

• Analizzi le prestazioni operative in base ai livelli di servizio, alla produttività, all'utilizzo e alle deviazioni di previsione e ne derivi misure mirate di miglioramento da questo

• È possibile utilizzare e configurare i sistemi WFM e CCaaS in modo operativo, tra cui per la gestione di abilità e code, routing, priorità, orari di apertura, circuiti ad hoc e annunci

• Per gli incidenti di rilevanza operativa, si valuta l'impatto, avvia misure operative immediate e coordina la cooperazione con gli organismi interni ed esterni

• Lavora a stretto contatto con Data & Analytics, il Contact Center Platform Specialist, la gestione CVC e altri stakeholder rilevanti

Ecco perché hai successo:

• Hai un apprendistato professionale completato con EFZ, un'ulteriore formazione nella gestione della forza lavoro, gestione del centro di contatto, amministrazione aziendale o gestione del processo è un vantaggio

• Porti esperienza professionale nella gestione della forza lavoro o nella gestione operativa di un centro di contatto

• In risorse, capacità e pianificazione del personale e gestione intraday avete esperienza pratica

• Capisci i rapporti tra previsione, volume, requisiti di risorse, personale, produttività, utilizzo, competenze e livelli di servizio e tradurre analisi in misure concrete

• Sei sistema-affine e esperto nel trattare con la gestione della forza lavoro, CCaaS e sistemi di assistenza clienti, la conoscenza di Calabrio, 3CLogic o ServiceNow sono un vantaggio

• Con il tuo modo di lavorare analitico, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione, tieni anche una panoramica in situazioni operative dinamiche.

• Comunica e coordina con fiducia, può guidare i dipendenti professionalmente e avere una buona conoscenza del tedesco.
Le competenze in inglese sono vantaggiose

Ecco alcuni dei nostri vantaggi:

• Ore lavorative: Viviamo il lavoro mobile con ore di lavoro individuali (anno) e/o lavoro part-time. Fino al 40% home office è possibile. L'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una priorità assoluta per noi, perché i dipendenti equilibrati e rilassati sono importanti per noi. L'acquisto di vacanze aggiuntive è possibile.

• Mobilità e cibo: riceverete un contributo per il telefono cellulare. Per il vostro cibo, offriamo anche un contributo.

• Istruzione e formazione: promuovere i dipendenti è una parte importante della nostra cultura. Approfittate del generoso sostegno all'istruzione e alla formazione interna ed esterna. Offriamo opportunità di carriera nelle funzioni gestionali, specialistiche e di progetto

• Salär: Con noi, puoi aspettarti una remunerazione basata sul mercato con una retribuzione assoluta pari a tutti i generi. I benefici pensione sono attraenti e si può scegliere quello giusto per voi da modelli diversi. L'assicurazione contro gli infortuni copre il dipartimento ospedaliero privato.

Ulteriori informazioni sui nostri vantaggi possono essere trovate nella nostra pagina di carriera.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As the largest real estate management service provider for demanding residential, office and commercial areas, we offer our customers a comprehensive all-round service package. With our centrally located Customer Value Center (CVC) near the train station in Winterthur, we provide tenants, interested parties and suppliers with a central point of contact. Through various channels, we ensure a service-oriented and multilingual customer dialogue.

With topics such as Quality & Education, Knowledge Management, Reporting & Analytics and Workforce Management, the Business Support department ensures efficient control of the contact center and continuously develops processes and systems.

To complement our existing team in Winterthur, we are looking for an expert and customer-oriented personality by agreement as

Workforce Manager (m/f/d)

Winterthur, 80-100 %

This is what moves you:

• You assume professional responsibility for workforce management, coordinate the employees working in the area and continuously develop processes, standards and control mechanisms

• Based on forecasts, analyses and demand scenarios, you derive the resource, capacity, skills and language requirements taking into account shrinkage and service goals and ensure predictive planning

• You are responsible for personnel planning as well as the calculation and control of holiday and absence quotas taking into account capacities, working time models, skills, languages and service objectives.

• You are responsible for operational intraday control, monitor volumes, capacities and service levels in real time and initiate targeted measures to ensure service and productivity goals in the event of deviations

• You analyze operational performance based on service levels, productivity, utilization and forecast deviations and derive targeted improvement measures from this

• You operate and configure the WFM and CCaaS systems operationally, including for skill and queue management, routing, prioritization, opening hours, ad hoc circuits and announcements

• For operationally relevant incidents, you assess the impact, initiate immediate operational measures and coordinate cooperation with internal and external bodies

• You work closely with Data & Analytics, the Contact Center Platform Specialist, CVC management and other relevant stakeholders

This is why you succeed:

• You have a completed vocational apprenticeship with EFZ, a further education in workforce management, contact center management, business administration or process management is an advantage

• You bring professional experience in workforce management or operational management of a contact center

• In resource, capacity and personnel planning as well as intraday management you have practical experience

• You understand the relationships between forecast, volume, resource requirements, staffing, productivity, utilization, skills and service levels and translate analyses into concrete measures

• You are system-affine and experienced in dealing with workforce management, CCaaS and customer service systems, knowledge of Calabrio, 3CLogic or ServiceNow are an advantage

• With your analytical, structured and solution-oriented way of working, you also keep an overview in dynamic operating situations.

• You communicate and coordinate confidently, can guide employees professionally and have very good knowledge of German.
English skills are beneficial

Here are some of our benefits:

• Working hours: We live mobile work with individual (year) working hours and/or part-time work. Up to 40% home office is possible. Work-life balance is a top priority for us, because balanced and relaxed employees are important to us. The purchase of additional holidays is possible.

• Mobility and food: You will receive a contribution for the mobile phone. For your food, we also make a contribution.

• Education and training: Promoting employees is an important part of our culture. Benefit from generous support in internal and external education and training. We offer career opportunities in management, specialist and project functions

• Salär: With us, you can expect a market-based remuneration with absolute equal pay for all genders. The pension benefits are attractive and you can choose the right one for you from different models. Accident protection insurance covers the private hospital department.

More information about our benefits can be found on our career page.

#Wincasa

En tant que plus grand fournisseur de services de gestion immobilière pour les zones résidentielles, de bureaux et commerciales exigeantes, nous offrons à nos clients un ensemble complet de services. Avec notre centre de valeur client (CVC) situé à proximité de la gare de Winterthur, nous fournissons aux locataires, aux parties intéressées et aux fournisseurs un point de contact central. Par différents canaux, nous garantissons un dialogue client axé sur le service et multilingue.

Avec des sujets tels que la qualité et l'éducation, la gestion des connaissances, les rapports et l'analyse et la gestion de la main-d'oeuvre, le service de soutien aux entreprises assure un contrôle efficace du centre de contact et développe continuellement des processus et des systèmes.

Pour compléter notre équipe existante à Winterthur, nous recherchons une personnalité experte et orientée vers le client par un accord

Gestionnaire des effectifs (h/f/d)

Winterthur, 80-100 %

C'est ce qui vous pousse:

• Vous assumez la responsabilité professionnelle de la gestion des effectifs, coordonnez les employés travaillant dans la région et développez continuellement des processus, des normes et des mécanismes de contrôle

• Sur la base de prévisions, d'analyses et de scénarios de demande, vous déterminez les ressources, les capacités, les compétences et les exigences linguistiques en tenant compte du rétrécissement et des objectifs de service et en assurant une planification prédictive

• Vous êtes responsable de la planification du personnel ainsi que du calcul et du contrôle des quotas de vacances et d'absences en tenant compte des capacités, des modèles de temps de travail, des compétences, des langues et des objectifs de service.

• Vous êtes responsable du contrôle opérationnel intrajournalier, surveillez les volumes, les capacités et les niveaux de service en temps réel et lancez des mesures ciblées pour assurer les objectifs de service et de productivité en cas d'écart

• Vous analysez le rendement opérationnel en fonction des niveaux de service, de la productivité, de l'utilisation et des écarts de prévisions et vous en tirez des mesures d'amélioration ciblées.

• Vous exploitez et configurez les systèmes WFM et CCaaS de manière opérationnelle, y compris pour la gestion des compétences et des files d'attente, l'acheminement, la priorisation, les heures d'ouverture, les circuits ad hoc et les annonces

• Pour les incidents pertinents sur le plan opérationnel, vous évaluez l'impact, prenez des mesures opérationnelles immédiates et coordonnez la coopération avec les organismes internes et externes.

• Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec Data & Analytics, le spécialiste de la plateforme du Centre de contact, la gestion CVC et d'autres parties prenantes concernées

C'est pourquoi vous réussissez:

• Vous avez un apprentissage professionnel terminé avec EFZ, une formation complémentaire en gestion de la main-d'œuvre, gestion des centres de contact, administration des entreprises ou gestion des processus est un avantage

• Vous apportez une expérience professionnelle dans la gestion des effectifs ou la gestion opérationnelle d'un centre de contact

• Dans la planification des ressources, des capacités et du personnel ainsi que dans la gestion intrajournalière, vous avez une expérience pratique

• Vous comprenez les relations entre les prévisions, le volume, les besoins en ressources, la dotation en personnel, la productivité, l'utilisation, les compétences et les niveaux de service et traduisez les analyses en mesures concrètes

• Vous avez l'expérience de la gestion des effectifs, du CCaaS et des systèmes de service à la clientèle, de la connaissance de Calabre, 3CLogic ou ServiceNow sont un avantage

• Avec votre façon de travailler analytique, structurée et orientée vers la solution, vous gardez également un aperçu dans des situations d'exploitation dynamiques.

• Vous communiquez et coordonnez en toute confiance, pouvez guider les employés de façon professionnelle et avoir une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand.
Les compétences en anglais sont bénéfiques

• Heures de travail: Nous vivons un travail mobile avec des heures de travail individuelles (année) et/ou à temps partiel. Jusqu'à 40% de bureau à domicile est possible. • Éducation et formation: La promotion des employés est un élément important de notre culture. Bénéficiez d'un soutien généreux dans l'éducation et la formation internes et externes. Nous offrons des opportunités de carrière dans les fonctions de gestion, de spécialiste et de projet

• Salär: Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à une rémunération basée sur le marché avec un salaire absolu égal pour tous les sexes. Les prestations de retraite sont attrayantes et vous pouvez choisir la bonne pour vous parmi différents modèles. L ' assurance contre les accidents couvre le service hospitalier privé.

descriptionByLocale.de:
An unserem Standort «Wohnen» in Olten fühlen sich die Mieter nicht nur wie zuhause, sondern werden durch unsere neue Aufgabenverteilung im Team auch optimal und effizient betreut. Das hat nicht nur Vorteile für Mietende und die Eigentümerschaft, sondern auch für dich. Durch mehr Spezialisierung im Team arbeiten wir enger zusammen, und alle können sich auf ihre Stärken konzentrieren.

Wenn dein Herz für Immobilien schlägt, du motiviert sowie zielorientiert bist und ausserdem gerne im Team arbeitest, dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung als

Immobilienbewirtschafter (m/w/d)

Olten, 70%

Das bewegst du:

• Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Bewirtschaftung eines Portefeuilles von Wohn- und gemischt genutzten Liegenschaften

• Dazu gehört die Sicherstellung des ordentlichen und ausserordentlichen Immobilienunterhalts, die Terminierung und Durchführung von Liegenschaftsbesichtigungen sowie Abnahmen

• Du stehst in Kontakt mit der Eigentümerschaft, Mieterschaft, Hauswartung, Handwerksbetrieben und Ämtern

• Das Verhandeln und Erstellen von Gewerbemietverträgen sowie des Jahresbudgets liegt ebenfalls in deinem Zuständigkeitsbereich

• Um all diesen Aufgaben gerecht zu werden, kannst du auf die Unterstützung sowohl von Teammitgliedern der technischen Bewirtschaftung und Vermietung zählen als auch der Sachbearbeitung und Hauswartung, welche du betreust

• Am Standort «Wohnen» kümmerst du dich zudem gemeinsam mit deinem Team um die persönliche Betreuung der Kundschaft vor Ort

Deshalb gelingt es dir:

• Du verfügst über eine kaufmännische Grundausbildung sowie einen Fachausweis Immobilienbewirtschaftung (oder befindest dich in der Ausbildung). Dazu bringst du mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich mit

• Digitale Affinität und fundierte PC- und Softwarekenntnisse setzt du in der Arbeit mit verschiedenen Systemen gekonnt täglich ein

• Eine effiziente und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit Verhandlungsgeschick qualifizieren dich im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen und anspruchsvollen Zielgruppen

• Eine hohe Dienstleistungs- und Kundenorientierung sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Gute Umgangsformen, hohe Belastbarkeit sowie Flexibilität und Ausdauer runden dein Profil ab

Hier einige unserer Benefits:

• Arbeitszeiten: Wir leben mobiles Arbeiten mit individueller (Jahres)-Arbeitszeit und/oder Teilzeitarbeit. Bis zu 40% Home-Office sind möglich. Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns grossgeschrieben, denn ausgeglichene und erholte Mitarbeitende sind uns wichtig. Der Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferien ist möglich.

• Mobilität und Verpflegung: Du erhältst einen Beitrag für das Mobiltelefon. Für deine Verpflegung leisten wir ebenfalls einen Beitrag.

• Aus- und Weiterbildung: Das Fördern von Mitarbeitenden ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil unserer Kultur. Profitiere von einer grosszügigen Unterstützung bei internen und externen Aus- und Weiterbildungen. Wir bieten Laufbahnmöglichkeiten in Führungs-, Fach- und Projektfunktionen

• Salär: Bei uns erwartet dich eine marktgerechte Entlöhnung mit absoluter Lohngleichheit für alle Geschlechter. Die Pensionskassenleistungen sind attraktiv und du kannst aus verschiedenen Modellen das für dich passende wählen. Die Unfallschutzversicherung deckt die private Spitalabteilung ab.

Weitere Informationen zu unseren Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

• Salär: Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à une rémunération basée sur le marché avec un salaire absolu égal pour tous les sexes. Les prestations de retraite sont attrayantes et vous pouvez choisir la bonne pour vous parmi différents modèles. L'assurance contre les accidents couvre le service hospitalier privé.

Plus d'informations sur nos avantages se trouvent sur notre page carrière.

Gestionnaire immobilier Junior à Senior (h/f/d)

Bâle Claraturm, 80-100 %

Come Consulente Legale (Senior) svolgete un ruolo centrale nel Gruppo Implenia e assumete la responsabilità legale per argomenti selezionati con particolare attenzione alla legge svizzera sulla costruzione e sugli appalti. Sei il primo punto di contatto per le nostre parti interessate interne e supporta le unità aziendali e le funzioni di Gruppo con una solida consulenza legale.

Il vostro luogo di lavoro è la nostra sede nella Ambasciatrice House di Opfikon, con la possibilità di lavorare in parte nella sede.

## Compiti: (Senior) Legal Counsel (m/f/d), Opfikon, 80-100 %

• In questo ruolo, si consiglia alle nostre unità operative (in particolare la costruzione di edifici) in modo completo su questioni legali – con un focus sulla legge svizzera sulla costruzione e sugli appalti.

• Si assume la gestione del rischio legale nelle procedure di offerta, trattative contrattuali e conclusioni (ad esempio contratti di acquisto immobiliare, contratti di lavoro e sviluppo di progetti, contratti di noleggio e di proprietà).

• Controllare, far valere e far valere rivendicazioni legali – o difenderle nell'interesse di Implenia.

• Inoltre, si conduce in modo indipendente contratti e trattative di regolamento e trovare soluzioni pragmatiche.

• Lei rappresenta Implenia in tribunali statali e autorità e coordina le società di diritto esterno.

• Attraverso la formazione interna, soprattutto nel diritto delle costruzioni e degli appalti, si rafforza la comprensione legale all'interno dell'azienda.

## Requisiti: (Senior) Legal Counsel (m/f/d), Opfikon, 80-100 %

• Hai completato con successo gli studi universitari in Svizzera (lic. iur./MLaw) con un brevetto di avvocato svizzero

• Porterai 4-6 anni di esperienza professionale come avvocato e/o legale, preferibilmente con esperienza nel diritto dell'edilizia.

• La vostra assertività e competenze di negoziazione, così come la vostra forte comunicazione e competenza di squadra vi distinguono

• Avete una rapida comprensione di questioni complesse, lavorare pragmaticamente e orientate alla soluzione e può comunicare argomenti legali in modo comprensibile ai non avvocati

• Un metodo di lavoro indipendente, veloce e attento così come un alto grado di impegno e resilienza sono una questione naturalmente per voi

• Hai competenze tedesche affidabili e molto buone in inglese, preferibilmente buone competenze italiane

## Vantaggi: (Senior) Legal Counsel (m/f/d), Opfikon, 80-100 %

• Un ambiente di lavoro multiculturale con la possibilità di plasmare un futuro degno di vivere

• Tecnologie all'avanguardia e un luogo di lavoro contemporaneo in un'azienda sostenibile

• Un'azienda che promuove il talento e la formazione dei propri dipendenti

• La sicurezza di un gruppo finanziariamente sano a larga base con radici forti in Svizzera

• Modelli di lavoro flessibili e attrezzature moderne di lavoro con possibilità di ufficio domestico

• Una selezione emozionante di vantaggi:

• 5 settimane vacanze e 9 giorni di ponte pagati

• un fondo pensione interno con una copertura molto buona e 3 livelli di contributo

• numerosi sconti sui noti fornitori di prodotti e servizi

Perché i nostri dipendenti amano lavorare per noi, si raccontano nel seguente video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8.

## Qual è il processo di applicazione a Implenia?

A Implenia, puoi aspettarti un processo di applicazione semplice e trasparente:

• Applicazione online con CV

• Chiamata iniziale personale per telefono, digitalmente o sul sito

• Seconda riunione e fase di offerta

## Che altro è importante per noi

A Implenia, apprezziamo e viviamo la diversità. Il nostro processo di reclutamento mira quindi a promuovere la diversità, l'uguaglianza e l'inclusione.

## Informazioni su Implenia

In qualità di fornitore leader di servizi edili e immobiliari svizzeri, Implenia sviluppa, realizza e gestisce spazi abitativi, ambienti di lavoro e infrastrutture per le generazioni future in Svizzera e Germania. Implenia offre anche progetti di tunnelling e infrastrutture correlate in altri mercati. L'azienda combina il know-how di unità di consulenza, sviluppo, pianificazione e esecuzione altamente qualificate sotto un tetto in un fornitore di servizi di costruzione e immobiliare integrato, multinazionale leader. Con sede a Opfikon nei pressi di Zurigo, Implenia impiega oltre 8.000 persone (FTE) in tutta Europa e raggiunge un fatturato di 3,5 miliardi di franchi nel 2025. Maggiori informazioni su implenia.com

*Chiediamo ai reclutatori di non presentare CV non richiesti. Tutte le conclusioni non sono considerate e non costituiscono un obbligo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As (Senior) Legal Counsel, you play a central role within the Implenia Group and assume legal responsibility for selected topics with a focus on Swiss construction and procurement law. You are the first point of contact for our internal stakeholders and support the business units and Group functions with sound legal advice.

Your place of work is our headquarters in the Ambassador House in Opfikon, with the possibility to work partly in the home office.

## Tasks: (Senior) Legal Counsel (m/f/d), Opfikon, 80-100 %

• In this role, you will advise our operational units (especially building construction) comprehensively on legal issues – with a focus on Swiss construction and procurement law.

• You take over legal risk management in bid procedures, contract negotiations and conclusions (e.g. real estate purchase contracts, work and project development contracts, rental and property contracts).

• You check, assert and enforce legal claims – or defend them in the interest of Implenia.

• In addition, you independently conduct contract and settlement negotiations and find pragmatic solutions.

• You represent Implenia in state courts and authorities and coordinate external law firms.

• Through internal training, especially in construction and procurement law, you strengthen the legal understanding within the company.

## Requirements: (Senior) Legal Counsel (m/f/d), Opfikon, 80-100 %

• You have successfully completed university studies in Switzerland (lic. iur./MLaw) with a Swiss lawyer patent

• You will bring 4-6 years of professional experience as a lawyer and/or legal counsel, preferably with experience in building law.

• Your assertiveness and negotiating skills as well as your strong communication and team competence distinguish you

• You have a quick understanding of complex issues, work pragmatically and solution-oriented and can communicate legal topics in an understandable way to non-lawyers

• An independent, fast and careful working method as well as a high degree of commitment and resilience are a matter of course for you

• You have reliable German and very good English skills, preferably good Italian skills

## Benefits: (Senior) Legal Counsel (m/f/d), Opfikon, 80-100 %

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living in

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• Flexible working models and modern work equipment with home office possibility

• An exciting selection of benefits:

• 5 weeks holidays and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

Why our employees like to work for us, they tell you themselves in the following video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8.

## What is the application process at Implenia?

At Implenia, you can expect a simple and transparent application process:

• Online application with CV

• Personal initial call by telephone, digitally or on site

• Second meeting and offer phase

## What else is important to us

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore aimed at promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

## About Implenia

As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com

*We ask recruiters not to submit unsolicited CVs. All submissions are not considered and do not constitute an obligation.

• Grâce à la formation interne, en particulier en droit de la construction et de l'approvisionnement, vous renforcez la compréhension juridique au sein de l'entreprise.

• Vous aurez 4-6 ans d'expérience professionnelle en tant qu'avocat et/ou conseiller juridique, de préférence avec l'expérience de la construction du droit.

• Votre assurance et vos compétences en matière de négociation, ainsi que votre solide compétence en communication et en équipe vous distinguent

• Vous avez une compréhension rapide des questions complexes, travaillez de manière pragmatique et orientée vers la solution et pouvez communiquer des sujets juridiques de manière compréhensible aux non-avocats

• Une méthode de travail indépendante, rapide et prudente ainsi qu'un haut degré d'engagement et de résilience sont une question de bien sûr pour vous

• Vous avez de bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais, de préférence en italien

## Prestations: (Aîné) Conseiller juridique (h/f/d), Opfikon, 80-100 %

• Un environnement de travail multiculturel avec la possibilité de façonner un futur qui mérite d'être vécu

• Technologies de pointe et lieu de travail contemporain dans une entreprise durable

• Une entreprise qui promeut le talent et la formation de ses employés

• La sécurité d'un groupe en bonne santé financière et à base large ayant de solides racines en Suisse

• Modèles de travail flexibles et équipements de travail modernes avec possibilité de bureau à domicile

• 5 semaines de vacances et 9 jours de pont payés

• de nombreux rabais sur les fournisseurs connus de produits et services

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per rafforzare il nostro nuovo team GU/TU nella regione di Zurigo, stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata e orientata al servizio come assistente di progetto: in esecuzione (80-100%). In questa versatile funzione, supporti il nostro progetto e i nostri responsabili delle costruzioni in tutte le questioni amministrative e contribuisci in modo significativo al buon funzionamento dei nostri progetti di costruzione.

Vuoi far parte del team di questo entusiasmante progetto e plasmare attivamente i nostri progetti di costruzione?

Quindi applicare online ora e diventare parte di Implenia!

## Compiti

Quali compiti vi aspettano come assistente di progetto GU/TU 80-100% (m/f/d), Opfikon?

• Come assistente di progetto, supporti il nostro progetto e i responsabili delle costruzioni in tutti i compiti amministrativi e organizzativi del business quotidiano.

• Crea corrispondenza, protocolli, presentazioni, valutazioni e statistiche specifiche del progetto

• Partecipa a gare, contratti di lavoro, ordini e processi amministrativi nell'approvvigionamento e nella contrazione

• Si guida il progetto di archiviazione, coordinate appuntamenti, organizzare eventi e garantire un flusso professionale di informazioni all'interno del team

• Lei sostiene nel trattamento delle fatture debitori e creditori, nonché in altri compiti amministrativi legati al progetto

## Requisiti

Quali requisiti porti come assistente di progetto GU/TU 80-100% (m/f/d), Opfikon?

• Formazione di base commerciale (KV) o formazione comparabile

• Prima esperienza professionale come assistente:in o impiegato:in un ambiente orientato al progetto, idealmente nella costruzione o nell'industria immobiliare

• Ottima conoscenza di Microsoft Office, in particolare Word e PowerPoint, nonché buona conoscenza di Excel

• Conoscenza sicura del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura nonché un metodo di lavoro strutturato, affidabile e indipendente

• Personalità orientata al team e orientata al servizio con un alto livello di capacità organizzativa e di fruizione di un ambiente di progetto dinamico

• Numero di affinità e metodo di lavoro strutturato

• Inoltre, sei innovativo, aperto, lungimirante e autosufficiente, hai l'umorismo e vuoi cambiare e migliorare le cose

Vantaggio:

• Conoscenza della contabilità con il programma RIB4.0

• Conoscenza della contabilità con SAP

• Buone competenze in inglese in Word e scrittura

## Vantaggi

• Un ambiente di lavoro multiculturale con la possibilità di plasmare un futuro degno di vivere

• Tecnologie all'avanguardia e un luogo di lavoro contemporaneo in un'azienda sostenibile

• Una società che promuove il talento e la formazione dei propri dipendenti

• La sicurezza di un gruppo finanziariamente sano con radici forti in Svizzera

• Modelli di lavoro flessibili fino al 40% home office

• Eccellente assicurazione di viaggio per voi e coloro che vivono nella stessa famiglia

• Una selezione emozionante di vantaggi:

• 5 settimane di vacanza (6 settimane dall'età 50) e 9 giorni di ponte pagati

• un fondo pensione interno con una copertura molto buona e 3 livelli di contributo

• numerosi sconti sui noti fornitori di prodotti e servizi

Perché i nostri dipendenti amano lavorare per noi, si raccontano nel seguente video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8.

## Qual è il processo di applicazione a Implenia?

A Implenia, puoi aspettarti un processo di applicazione semplice e trasparente:

• Applicazione online con CV

• Chiamata iniziale personale per telefono, digitalmente o sul sito

• Seconda riunione e fase di offerta

## Che altro è importante per noi

A Implenia, apprezziamo e viviamo la diversità. Il nostro processo di reclutamento mira quindi a promuovere la diversità, l'uguaglianza e l'inclusione.

## Informazioni su Implenia

Come fornitore leader di servizi edili e immobiliari svizzeri, Implenia sviluppa, realizza e gestisce spazi abitativi, ambienti di lavoro e infrastrutture per le generazioni future in Svizzera e Germania. Implenia offre anche progetti di tunnelling e infrastrutture correlate in altri mercati. L'azienda combina il know-how di unità di consulenza, sviluppo, pianificazione e esecuzione altamente qualificate sotto un tetto in un fornitore di servizi di costruzione e immobiliare integrato, multinazionale leader. Con sede a Opfikon nei pressi di Zurigo, Implenia impiega oltre 8.000 persone (FTE) in tutta Europa e raggiunge un fatturato di 3,5 miliardi di franchi nel 2025. Maggiori informazioni su implenia.com.

*Chiediamo ai reclutatori di non presentare CV non richiesti. Tutte le conclusioni non sono considerate e non costituiscono un obbligo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
To strengthen our new GU/TU team in the Zurich region, we are looking for a committed and service-oriented personality as a project assistant: in execution (80-100%). In this versatile function, you support our project and construction managers in all administrative matters and contribute significantly to the smooth running of our construction projects.

Do you want to be part of the team of this exciting project and actively shape our construction projects?

Then apply online now and become part of Implenia!

## Tasks

Which tasks await you as project assistant GU/TU 80-100% (m/f/d), Opfikon?

• As a project assistant, you support our project and construction managers in all administrative and organizational tasks of day-to-day business.

• You create correspondences, protocols, presentations as well as project-specific evaluations and statistics

• You participate in tenders, work contracts, orders and administrative processes in procurement and contracting

• You lead the project filing, coordinate appointments, organize events and ensure a professional flow of information within the team

• You support in the processing of debtor and creditor invoices as well as in other project-related administrative tasks

## Requirements

What requirements do you bring as project assistant GU/TU 80-100% (m/f/d), Opfikon?

• Commercial basic training (KV) or comparable training

• First professional experience as an assistant:in or clerk:in a project-oriented environment, ideally in the construction or real estate industry

• Very good knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Word and PowerPoint, as well as good knowledge of Excel

• Confident knowledge of German in words and writing as well as a structured, reliable and independent working method

• Team-oriented, service-oriented personality with a high level of organizational ability and enjoyment of a dynamic project environment

• Number affinity and structured working method

• In addition, you are innovative, open, far-sighted and self-confident, have humor and want to change and improve things

Advantage:

• Knowledge of accounting with the program RIB4.0

• Knowledge of Accounting with SAP

• Good English skills in Word and Writing

## Benefits

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• Flexible working models with up to 40% home office

• Excellent travel insurance for you and those living in the same household

• An exciting selection of benefits:

• 5 weeks of vacation (6 weeks from age 50) and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

Why our employees like to work for us, they tell you themselves in the following video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8.

## What is the application process at Implenia?

At Implenia, you can expect a simple and transparent application process:

• Online application with CV

• Personal initial call by telephone, digitally or on site

• Second meeting and offer phase

## What else is important to us

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore aimed at promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

## About Implenia

As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com.

*We ask recruiters not to submit unsolicited CVs. All submissions are not considered and do not constitute an obligation.

jobs.description:
Als führende Immobilienbewirtschaftungsdienstleisterin für anspruchsvolle Wohn-, Büro- und Gewerbeflächen bieten wir unserer Kundschaft umfassende Dienstleistungen rund um die Immobilie.

Technik, Immobilien und Verantwortung sind genau dein Ding? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns den zuverlässigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer Immobilien.

Zur Ergänzung unseres Teams in Zürich suchen wir eine motivierte und engagierte Persönlichkeit als

Junior Technische*r Leiter*in (m/w/d)

Zürich, 80%

Das bewegst du:

• Du unterstützt die technische Leitung bei der Steuerung des FM-Providers und seiner Partnerfirmen im technischen und infrastrukturellen Gebäudemanagement. Bei kleineren Mandaten übernimmst du diese Aufgabe eigenständig

• Du bist Ansprechperson für Mieterinnen und Mieter bei fachlichen und technischen Fragestellungen und sorgst für eine professionelle Lösungsfindung

• Du bringst dich aktiv in spannende Bau- und Sanierungsvorhaben ein, unterstützt die Bauherrentreuhand bei der Umsetzung und steuerst kleinere technische Massnahmen eigenständig – von der Idee bis zum Abschluss

Junior Technical Director (m/f/d)

Zurich, 80 %

This function is aimed at young professionals with a technical or commercial background who want to develop further in technical building management and have the following profile:

• You have a basic technical or commercial education. Further education at university level, for example in facility management or real estate management, is an advantage

• First professional experience in a comparable function, in facility management, in the real estate industry or in the project environment is an advantage

• You are well versed in dealing with the common Microsoft Office applications and ideally bring your first knowledge of project management

• You bring your own initiative and work independently, committed and solution-oriented

• Thanks to your planning and organizational strength, you can keep an overview even in challenging situations

• You communicate safely, act binding and can assert yourself against different stakeholders

• You think networked, act entrepreneurially and enjoy understanding technical and infrastructural connections

• You have stylish knowledge of German; Knowledge of English is an advantage.

Here are some of our benefits:

Working hours: We live mobile work with individual (year) working hours and/or part-time work. Up to 40% home office is possible. Work-life balance is a top priority for us, because balanced and relaxed employees are important to us. The purchase of additional holidays is possible.

Mobility and food: You will receive a contribution for the mobile phone. For your food, we also make a contribution.

Education and training: Promoting employees is an important part of our culture. Benefit from generous support in internal and external education and training. We offer career opportunities in management, specialist and project functions.

Salär: With us you can expect a market-based remuneration with absolute equal pay for all genders. The pension benefits are attractive and you can choose the right one for you from different models. The accident protection insurance covers the private hospital department.

More information about our benefits can be found on our career page.

To complement an existing team in Kriens, we are looking for an expert, committed and sociable personality as

Real Estate Site Manager (m/f/d)
Central Switzerland, Mittelland, 80-100 %

This is what moves you:

• You act as the first point of contact and main contact: in for the properties and take over a central coordination and interface function between owners, tenants, customers and other stakeholders.

• You are responsible for the further development and increase of the attractiveness of the shopping center, commercial real estate or areas as well as its strengthening and publicity

• You conduct negotiations with owners, authorities and tenants

• You lead steering meetings with the ownership and your team

• You take over the leadership and the further development of the subordinate employees (team leader level)

• You are responsible for preparing decisions for asset management in the areas of budget compliance, maintenance, marketing and marketing measures

• You take over the responsibility and security of commercial management, technical facility management, marketing and marketing

This is why you succeed:

• You have a degree in business administration, real estate management or a comparable education and bring several years of professional experience in a comparable function, ideally in real estate, retail or center management.

• Entrepreneurial thinking and action as well as the ability to successfully develop locations distinguish you.

• With your sense of customers, markets and people as well as your strong service orientation, you recognize opportunities and create sustainable added value.

• Thanks to your confident appearance, communication and negotiating strength, you move confidently at all levels and build sustainable relationships.

• You convince through high leadership and social competence and enjoy motivating people, driving change and achieving success together.

• A structured, independent and solution-oriented way of working, combined with good project management skills, rounds off your profile.

• Your assertiveness, resilience and initiative as well as your passion for real estate, retail and the development of locations make you the ideal complement for our team

Here are some of our benefits:

• Working hours: We live mobile work with individual (year) working hours and/or part-time work. Up to 40% home office is possible. Work-life balance is a top priority for us, because balanced and relaxed employees are important to us. The purchase of additional holidays is possible.

• Mobility and food: You will receive a contribution for the mobile phone. For your food, we also make a contribution.

• Education and training: Promoting employees is an important part of our culture. Benefit from generous support in internal and external education and training. We offer career opportunities in management, specialist and project functions

• Salär: With us, you can expect a market-based remuneration with absolute equal pay for all genders. The pension benefits are attractive and you can choose the right one for you from different models. Accident protection insurance covers the private hospital department.

More information about our benefits can be found on our career page.

Zur Ergänzung eines bestehenden Teams in Kriens, suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine fachkompetente, engagierte und kontaktfreudige Persönlichkeit als

Real Estate Site Manager (m/w/d)
Zentralschweiz, Mittelland, 80-100%

Das bewegst du:

• Du fungierst als erste Anlaufstelle und Hauptansprechpartner:in für die Liegenschaften und übernimmst eine zentrale Koordinations- und Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Eigentümern, Mietern, Kunden sowie weiteren Stakeholdern.

• Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung und die Steigerung der Attraktivität des Shopping Center, Gewerbeimmobilien oder Arealen sowie dessen Stärkung sowie Bekanntmachung

• Du führst Verhandlungen mit Eigentümern, Behörden sowie Mietern

• Du führst Steuerungsmeetings mit der Eigentümerschaft und deinem Team

• Du übernimmst die Führung und die Weiterentwicklung der unterstellten Mitarbeiter (Teamleiter Stufe)

• Dir obliegt die Entscheidungsvorbereitung fürs Asset Management in den Themen Budgeteinhaltung, Instandhaltungs-, Marketings- und Vermarktungsmassnahmen

• Du übernimmst die Sicherstellung und die Verantwortung der Bereiche Kaufmännische Bewirtschaftung, Technisches Facility Management, Vermarktung und Marketing

Deshalb gelingt es dir:

• Dank deines sicheren Auftretens sowie deiner Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke bewegst du dich souverän auf allen Ebenen und baust tragfähige Beziehungen auf.

• Du überzeugst durch hohe Führungs- und Sozialkompetenz und hast Freude daran, Menschen zu motivieren, Veränderungen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam Erfolge zu erzielen.

• Eine strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, kombiniert mit guten Projektmanagement-Kompetenzen, rundet dein Profil ab.

jobs.description:
Wir suchen ein/e Bauleiter:in GU/TU (Neubau) für die Region Zürich mit Anstellungsort in Opfikon . Bei uns erwarten dich spannende Projekte - von Geschäfts- und Wohnungsbauten über Hochhäuser bis hin zu Industrie- und Data-Centerbauten bieten wir dir eine moderne Arbeitsumgebung. Zudem sind für uns moderne Arbeitsmethoden wie LEAN-Construction und BIM nicht nur Theorie, sondern werden umfassend und konsequent in unseren Projekten umgesetzt.

## Aufgaben

Welche Aufgaben erwarten dich als Bauleiter GU/TU Zürich (w/m/d)?

• Als Bauleiter:in führst, realisierst und koordinierst du Neubauprojekte vom Projektbeginn bis zur mängelfreien Übergabe als GU/TU

• Du devisierst und führst aktiv den Vergabeprozess an Subunternehmer

• Du führst Baustellen im Team unter Berücksichtigung der sicherheitstechnischen, terminlichen, qualitativen und quantitativen Vorgaben

• Du bist die Drehscheibe vor Ort und erster Ansprechpartner für Subunternehmer, Lieferanten, Planer, der Bauherrschaft und Behörden

## Anforderungen

Welche Anforderungen bringst du mit als Bauleiter GU/TU Zürich (w/m/d)?

• Dipl. Bauleiter:in, Techniker:in TS, Hochbauzeichner:in oder gleichwertige Ausbildung/Weiterbildung

• Mehrjährige Bauleitungserfahrung in Projekten im Bereich Neubau (GU/TU)

• Du besitzt sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Du bist teamfähig, ein guter Organisator, verantwortungsbewusst, ergebnisorientiert, flexibel, belastbar, arbeitest proaktiv, effizient und besitzt ein gesundes Durchsetzungsvermögen

## Benefits

• Ein multikulturelles Arbeitsumfeld mit der Chance, eine lebenswerte Zukunft mitzugestalten

• Modernste Technologien und einen zeitgemässen Arbeitsplatz bei einem nachhaltigen Unternehmen

• Ein Unternehmen, das Talente und die Weiterbildung seiner Mitarbeitenden fördert

• Die Sicherheit eines finanziell gesunden, breit aufgestellten Konzerns mit starken Wurzeln in der Schweiz

• Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit bis zu 40% Homeoffice

• Eine hervorragende Reiseversicherung für dich und im gleichen Haushalt lebende Personen

• Eine spannende Auswahl an Benefits:

• 5 Wochen Ferien (6 Wochen ab dem 50. Lebensjahr) und 9 bezahlte Brückentage

• eine hauseigene Pensionskasse mit sehr gutem Deckungsgrad und 3 Beitragsstufen

• zahlreiche Preisnachlässe auf namhafte Anbieter von Produkt- und Dienstleistungen

Quali compiti vi aspettano come direttore di costruzione (m/f/d) Struttura, espansione e architettura - Data Center?

• Condurre e coordinare tutti i lavori CSA (Civil, Structural & Architectural) su un grande progetto di data center e garantire una corretta implementazione in termini di sicurezza del lavoro, qualità, costi e scadenze.

• Si guida e coordina subappaltatori, lucidatori e team cantiere e sono responsabili per la pianificazione di costruzione a breve e medio termine utilizzando la previsione di 2, 4 e 8 settimane, nonché il coordinamento quotidiano del cantiere

• Monitorerai i progressi della costruzione, la produttività e l'utilizzo delle risorse, identificherai i rischi e i colli di bottiglia in una fase precoce e avvierai misure appropriate per proteggere le pietre miliari del progetto

• Garantisci il rispetto di tutte le specifiche del progetto, norme e regolamenti svizzeri, norme SIA, requisiti di protezione antincendio, linee guida HSE e processi di gestione della qualità

• Esperienza approfondita sul data center iperscale, progetti di costruzione complessi, critici, industriali o comparabili, nonché una forte comprensione delle interfacce tra gli scambi CSA e MEP

descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to strengthen our growing Data Center team, we are looking for an experienced personality as a construction manager in shell construction, expansion and architecture (CSA). Your contractual place of work is our headquarters “Connect” in Opfikon. However, you will mainly work on one of our data center construction projects in the Zurich region.

## Tasks

What tasks await you as construction manager (m/f/d) Structure, expansion and architecture - Data Center?

• You lead and coordinate all CSA work (Civil, Structural & Architectural) on a large data center project and ensure successful implementation in terms of work safety, quality, costs and deadlines.

• You lead and coordinate subcontractors, polishers and construction site teams and are responsible for short- and medium-term construction planning using 2-, 4- and 8-week foresight as well as daily construction site coordination

• You control the central interfaces between the CSA and MEP trades and ensure that workspaces, rooms and systems are handed over to the installation and commissioning teams on schedule.

• You will monitor construction progress, productivity and resource use, identify risks and bottlenecks at an early stage and initiate appropriate measures to secure the project milestones

• You ensure compliance with all project specifications, Swiss standards and regulations, SIA standards, fire protection requirements, HSE guidelines and quality management processes

## Requirements

What requirements do you bring as construction manager (m/f/d) shell construction, expansion and architecture - Data Center?

• Several years of experience in construction with comprehensive responsibility in construction site management as well as proven success in the realization of CSA trades from execution to commissioning to handover

• In-depth experience on hyperscale data center, mission critical, industrial or comparable complex construction projects as well as a strong understanding of the interfaces between CSA and MEP trades

• Proven competence in controlling multiple subcontractors simultaneously as well as in short- and medium-term construction schedule planning, scheduling, productivity monitoring and management of dependencies and bottlenecks

• In-depth technical understanding of implementation plans, BIM models, technical specifications and schedules as well as experience in quality controls, defect management and structured project transfers

• Completed studies or comparable training in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related discipline. Knowledge of Swiss building standards (SIA/VKF), experience on large projects and knowledge of Primavera P6 are advantageous

• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

## Benefits

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living in

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• Excellent travel insurance for you and those living in the same household

• An exciting selection of benefits:

• 5 weeks of vacation (6 weeks from age 50) and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

Why our employees like to work for us, they tell you themselves in the following video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8.

## What is the application process at Implenia?

At Implenia, you can expect a simple and transparent application process:

• Online application with CV

• Personal initial call by telephone, digitally or on site

• Second meeting and offer phase

## What else is important to us

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore aimed at promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

## About Implenia

As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com.

En tant que premier fournisseur suisse de services immobiliers et de construction, Implenia développe, réalise et gère des espaces de vie, des environnements de travail et des infrastructures pour les générations futures en Suisse et en Allemagne. As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com

For the Tunneling Switzerland department, we are looking for you as a project manager to strengthen our team for Western Switzerland (and the whole of Switzerland as required).

## You move that

• Independent management of small and larger complex tunnelling projects

• Cooperation in the acquisition

• Responsibility for Profit + Lost of own projects

• Resource and operational planning

• Personnel management of construction site managers and the construction site cadre

• Competent contact for builders, planners and business partners

• Cooperation with local partners, subcontractors, suppliers and authorities

• Support for projects at AVOR

• Procurement of subcontracting services and materials in cooperation with Procurement incl. Postponement of contracts

• Supplementary management, independent preparation and enforcement of supplementary offers

• Financial and technical project controlling

## This is why you succeed

• Graduation and qualification: You have a degree as a civil engineer or a comparable training and already have experience in underground construction.

• Computer skills: You are a routine, skilled user of MS Office. Experience in scheduling with MS Project or TILOS is an advantage.

• Working method: You are used to working in a team, think analytically and networked and work independently and efficiently on the tasks assigned to you. In addition, you are characterized by a high sense of responsibility, good organizational skills and a high degree of flexibility.

• Language skills: Good French and German skills are required. If you have additional knowledge in English and/or Italian, this is very welcome.

## This is what we offer you

• Innovative and sustainable working environment

• Use of modern technologies

• Support for employee development (promotion of further education by the Implenia Academy)

• Implenia-Benefits, including (to name a few):

• a company-owned pension fund with three contribution levels: Implenia Provision

• 5 weeks of vacation plus 9 bridge days

• Travel insurance for you and everyone living in your household

• Benefits for Implenia employees on products and services

Do you share our passion for building? Become part of Implenia! We look forward to receiving your online application indicating your earliest possible start date. Is this job not interesting for you, but maybe for one of your friends or acquaintances? Then forward the ad with the “Share” function at the foot of the page. Thank you very much.

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore focused on promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

*We ask recruiters not to submit unsolicited CVs. All submissions are not considered and do not constitute an obligation.

## Questions?

Martina Popovic, Talent Acquisition Partner Division Buildings, is happy to answer your questions by email: martina.popovic@implenia.com
