descriptionByLocale.de:
Gute Gebäude entstehen nicht zufällig. Sie beginnen mit einer durchdachten Planung. Wenn du genau dafür brennst, dann suchen wir dich als Elektroplaner (m/w/d).

## Aufgaben

Welche Aufgaben erwarten dich als Juniorprojektleiter Elektro (m/w/d), Gisikon, 80-100%?

Du bist verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Abwicklung deiner Projekte in den Segmenten «Gewerbe- und Bürobauten», «Wohnbauten», «Industrie» sowie «Dienstleistung» und hast den Überblick über Kosten, Qualität und Termine. Dein zugewiesenes Planungsteam begleitest du in den jeweiligen Teilaufgaben der Projekte. Unseren Auftraggeberinnen und Partnern stehst du als kompetente Ansprechperson zur Seite.

• Projektierung, Devisierung und Ausführungsplanung

• 3D-Modellierung

• Fachbauleitung

• Besprechung und Protokollführung mit GU, Bauherr, Architekten und weiteren Fachplanern

## Anforderungen

Welche Anforderungen bringst du mit als Juniorprojektleiter Elektro (m/w/d), Gisikon, 80-100%?

• Ausbildung als Gebäudetechnikplaner/in EFZ Fachrichtung Elektro oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem Planungsbüro, erste Erfahrungen in der Projektleitung von Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse in MS-Office, sowie CAD (Nova), idealerweise Erfahrung mit BIM

• Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

• Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Projektbeteiligten

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

## Benefits

• Ein multikulturelles Arbeitsumfeld mit der Chance, eine lebenswerte Zukunft mitzugestalten

• Modernste Technologien und einen zeitgemässen Arbeitsplatz bei einem nachhaltigen Unternehmen

• Ein Unternehmen, das Talente und die Weiterbildung seiner Mitarbeitenden fördert

• Die Sicherheit eines finanziell gesunden, breit aufgestellten Konzerns mit starken Wurzeln in der Schweiz

• Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit bis zu 40% Homeoffice

• Eine hervorragende Reiseversicherung für dich und im gleichen Haushalt lebende Personen

• Eine spannende Auswahl an Benefits:

• 5 Wochen Ferien (6 Wochen ab dem 50. Lebensjahr) und 9 bezahlte Brückentage

• eine hauseigene Pensionskasse mit sehr gutem Deckungsgrad und 3 Beitragsstufen

• zahlreiche Preisnachlässe auf namhafte Anbieter von Produkt- und Dienstleistungen

Wenn Du dich in dieser Beschreibung wiederfindest und Teil von Planovita werden möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

## Wie läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei Planovita ab?

Bei Planovita erwartet dich ein einfacher und transparenter Bewerbungsprozess:

• Online-Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf

• Persönliches Erstgespräch per Telefon, digital oder vor Ort

• Zweitgespräch und Angebotsphase

## Was uns noch wichtig ist

Bei Planovita schätzen und leben wir Diversität. Unser Rekrutierungsprozess ist daher auf die Förderung von Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion ausgerichtet.

## Planovita ist Teil von Implenia

Als führender Schweizer Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister entwickelt, realisiert und bewirtschaftet Implenia Lebensräume, Arbeitswelten und Infrastruktur für künftige Generationen in der Schweiz und in Deutschland. Zudem bietet Implenia in weiteren Märkten Tunnelbau- und damit verbundene Infrastrukturprojekte. Das Unternehmen fasst das Know-how aus hochqualifizierten Beratungs-, Entwicklungs-, Planungs- und Ausführungseinheiten unter einem Dach zu einem integrierten, multinational führenden Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister zusammen. Herzlich willkommen bei Planovita!

Wir füllen Gebäudetechnikplanung mit Leben – smart, effizient, nachhaltig!

Unser heutiges Unternehmen mit seinen rund 30 Mitarbeitenden kann auf eine vieljährige, bewegte Geschichte zurückblicken. Wobei Rückblicke eigentlich nicht unser Ding sind – wir sehen lieber nach vorne! Hierfür haben wir viele der klügsten und fortschrittlichsten Köpfe unserer Branche gewinnen können.

Nella nostra posizione "Wohnen" a Baden, gli inquilini non solo si sentono a casa, ma sono anche gestiti in modo ottimale ed efficiente dalla nostra nuova divisione di compiti nella squadra. Questo non solo ha vantaggi per gli inquilini e la proprietà, ma anche per voi. Attraverso una maggiore specializzazione nella squadra, lavoriamo più strettamente insieme, e tutti possono concentrarsi sui loro punti di forza.

Se il tuo cuore batte per il settore immobiliare, sei motivato, orientato verso l'obiettivo e anche come lavorare in una squadra, allora non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione come

Responsabile immobiliare (m/f/d)

Bagno, 80-100 %

Questo è ciò che ti muove:

• Si assume la responsabilità di gestire un portafoglio di proprietà residenziali e miste

• Questo include garantire la manutenzione immobiliare regolare e straordinaria, terminare e svolgere visite immobiliari e accettazione.

• Siete in contatto con la proprietà, inquilino, manutenzione della casa, imprese artigianali e uffici

• Negoziare e redigere contratti di locazione aziendale e il bilancio annuale è anche vostra responsabilità.

• Al fine di soddisfare tutte queste attività, è possibile contare sul supporto dei membri del team di gestione tecnica e noleggio, nonché sulla gestione e la manutenzione domestica che si fornisce.

• Nella posizione "Vivere", ti occuperai anche del supporto personale dei clienti locali insieme al tuo team.

Ecco perché hai successo:

• Hai una formazione commerciale di base e una carta di gestione immobiliare (o sono in formazione). Inoltre, si porta diversi anni di esperienza professionale in questa zona

• L'affinità digitale e la conoscenza approfondita del PC e del software sono abilmente utilizzate quotidianamente nel lavoro con diversi sistemi

• Un metodo di lavoro efficiente e orientato agli obiettivi e buone capacità di comunicazione con competenze di negoziazione si qualificano nel trattare con gruppi target diversi e esigenti

• Un servizio elevato e l'orientamento del cliente sono una questione naturalmente per voi

• Buone maniere, elevata capacità di carico e flessibilità e resistenza completano il tuo profilo

Ecco alcuni dei nostri vantaggi:

• Ore lavorative: Viviamo il lavoro mobile con ore di lavoro individuali (anno) e/o lavoro part-time. Fino al 40% home office è possibile. L'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una priorità assoluta per noi, perché i dipendenti equilibrati e rilassati sono importanti per noi. L'acquisto di vacanze aggiuntive è possibile.

• Mobilità e cibo: riceverete un contributo per il telefono cellulare. Per il vostro cibo, offriamo anche un contributo.

• Istruzione e formazione: promuovere i dipendenti è una parte importante della nostra cultura. Approfittate del generoso sostegno all'istruzione e alla formazione interna ed esterna. Offriamo opportunità di carriera nelle funzioni gestionali, specialistiche e di progetto

• Salär: Con noi, puoi aspettarti una remunerazione basata sul mercato con una retribuzione assoluta pari a tutti i generi. I benefici pensione sono attraenti e si può scegliere quello giusto per voi da modelli diversi. L'assicurazione contro gli infortuni copre il dipartimento ospedaliero privato.

Ulteriori informazioni sui nostri vantaggi possono essere trovate nella nostra pagina di carriera.

At our "Wohnen" location in Baden, tenants not only feel at home, but are also managed optimally and efficiently by our new division of tasks in the team. This not only has advantages for tenants and ownership, but also for you. Through more specialization in the team, we work more closely together, and everyone can focus on their strengths.

If your heart beats for real estate, you are motivated, goal-oriented and also like to work in a team, then we look forward to your application as

Real estate manager (m/f/d)

Bathing, 80-100 %

This is what moves you:

• You take responsibility for managing a portfolio of residential and mixed-use properties

• This includes ensuring regular and extraordinary real estate maintenance, terminating and carrying out real estate visits and acceptances.

• You are in contact with the ownership, tenant, house maintenance, craft businesses and offices

• Negotiating and drawing up business lease contracts as well as the annual budget is also your responsibility.

• In order to meet all these tasks, you can count on the support of both technical management and rental team members as well as the handling and home maintenance that you provide.

• At the "Living" location, you will also take care of the personal support of the local customers together with your team.

This is why you succeed:

• You have a basic commercial education and a real estate management card (or are in training). In addition, you bring several years of professional experience in this area

• Digital affinity and in-depth PC and software knowledge are skillfully used daily in working with different systems

• An efficient and goal-oriented working method as well as good communication skills with negotiation skills qualify you in dealing with different and demanding target groups

• A high service and customer orientation are a matter of course for you

• Good manners, high load capacity as well as flexibility and endurance round off your profile

Here are some of our benefits:

• Working hours: We live mobile work with individual (year) working hours and/or part-time work. Up to 40% home office is possible. Work-life balance is a top priority for us, because balanced and relaxed employees are important to us. The purchase of additional holidays is possible.

• Mobility and food: You will receive a contribution for the mobile phone. For your food, we also make a contribution.

• Education and training: Promoting employees is an important part of our culture. Benefit from generous support in internal and external education and training. We offer career opportunities in management, specialist and project functions

• Salär: With us, you can expect a market-based remuneration with absolute equal pay for all genders. The pension benefits are attractive and you can choose the right one for you from different models. Accident protection insurance covers the private hospital department.

More information about our benefits can be found on our career page.

Con noi, non si entra in un'organizzazione rigida. Diventerai parte di un team in crescita con un sacco di potenziale e l'opportunità di plasmare attivamente l'ulteriore sviluppo della pianificazione elettrica.

## Compiti

Quali compiti vi aspettano come Project Manager Electric Planning (m/f/d), Gisikon / Opfikon / Bern?

• Progettazione indipendente e realizzazione di progetti elettrici esigenti dallo studio preliminare alla consegna al cliente

• Responsabilità per qualità, costi e scadenze in tutte le fasi del progetto

• Sviluppo di concetti e sviluppo di onori e documenti applicativi

• Leadership e coordinamento dei team di progetto assegnati

• Garantire un'implementazione di progetto economica e di alta qualità

## Requisiti

Quali requisiti porti con te come project manager pianificazione elettrica (m/f/d), Gisikon / Opfikon / Bern?

• Allenamento elettrico planner EFZ (m/f/d), ideale con ulteriore formazione a HF, FH o qualifica equivalente

• Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti di impianti di tecnologia edilizio in un ufficio di ingegneria

• Conoscenza CAD molto buona e divertimento dei metodi di pianificazione digitale

• Metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione

## Vantaggi

• Un ambiente di lavoro multiculturale con la possibilità di plasmare un futuro degno di vivere

• Tecnologie all'avanguardia e un luogo di lavoro contemporaneo in un'azienda sostenibile

• Una società che promuove il talento e la formazione dei propri dipendenti

• 5 settimane di vacanza (6 settimane dall'età 50) e 9 giorni di ponte pagati

Se ti trovi in questa descrizione e vuoi diventare parte di Planovita, non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione.

## Qual è il processo di applicazione a Planovita?

A Plaovita puoi aspettarti un processo di applicazione semplice e trasparente:

• Applicazione online con CV

• Chiamata iniziale personale per telefono, digitalmente o sul sito

• Seconda riunione e fase di offerta

## Che altro è importante per noi

A Planovita, apprezziamo e viviamo la diversità. Il nostro processo di reclutamento si concentra quindi sulla promozione della diversità, dell'uguaglianza e dell'inclusione.

## Planovita fa parte di Implenia

In qualità di fornitore leader di servizi edili e immobiliari svizzeri, Implenia sviluppa, realizza e gestisce spazi abitativi, ambienti di lavoro e infrastrutture per le generazioni future in Svizzera e Germania. Implenia offre anche progetti di tunnelling e infrastrutture correlate in altri mercati. L'azienda combina il know-how di unità di consulenza, sviluppo, pianificazione e esecuzione altamente qualificate sotto un tetto in un fornitore di servizi di costruzione e immobiliare integrato e multinazionale. Con sede a Opfikon nei pressi di Zurigo, Implenia impiega oltre 8.000 persone (FTE) in tutta Europa e raggiunge un fatturato di 3,5 miliardi di franchi nel 2025. Maggiori informazioni su implenia.com.

Benvenuti a Planovita!

Riempiamo la pianificazione della tecnologia di costruzione con la vita – intelligente, efficiente, sostenibile!

La nostra attuale società con i suoi circa 30 dipendenti può guardare indietro su una lunga, storia evento. Per cui le retrospettive non sono in realtà la nostra cosa – preferiamo guardare avanti! Abbiamo vinto molte delle menti più brillanti e più avanzate del nostro settore.

Oggi siamo per l'implementazione competente delle ultime tecnologie, come BIM – tutto nello spirito di una sostenibilità efficiente. Oltre alla fase di progettazione e realizzazione, prendiamo sempre in considerazione il funzionamento ottimizzato delle piante e degli oggetti.

Qui si ottiene interessanti sfondi su Planovita, il vostro life-like specialista planner per la tecnologia di costruzione!

Chiediamo ai reclutatori di non presentare i CV. Le richieste non richieste non sono considerate e non costituiscono un diritto a pagamento.

With us, you do not enter a rigid organization. You will become part of a growing team with a lot of potential and the opportunity to actively shape the further development of electrical planning.

## Tasks

Which tasks await you as Project Manager Electrical Planning (m/f/d), Gisikon / Opfikon / Bern?

• Independent planning and implementation of demanding electrical projects from the preliminary study to the handover to the client

• Responsibility for quality, costs and deadlines across all project phases

• Development of concepts as well as development of honorariums and application documents

• Leadership and coordination of assigned project teams

• Collaboration with clients, architects, specialist planners and other project participants

• Ensuring an economical and high-quality project implementation

## Requirements

What requirements do you bring with you as project manager electrical planning (m/f/d), Gisikon / Opfikon / Bern?

• Electrical planner training EFZ (m/f/d), ideally with further training at HF, FH or equivalent qualification

• Experience in project management of building technology plants at an engineering office

• Very good CAD knowledge and enjoyment of digital planning methods

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method

• Strength of communication and enjoyment of working with different stakeholders

## Benefits

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living in

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• Flexible working models with up to 40% home office

• Excellent travel insurance for you and those living in the same household

• An exciting selection of benefits:

• 5 weeks of vacation (6 weeks from age 50) and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

If you find yourself in this description and want to become part of Planovita, we look forward to your application.

## What is the application process at Planovita?

At Plaovita you can expect a simple and transparent application process:

• Online application with CV

• Personal initial call by telephone, digitally or on site

• Second meeting and offer phase

## What else is important to us

At Planovita, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore focused on promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

## Planovita is part of Implenia

As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com.

Welcome to Planovita!

We fill building technology planning with life – smart, efficient, sustainable!

Our current company with its approximately 30 employees can look back on a long, eventful history. Whereby retrospectives are actually not our thing – we prefer to look forward! We have won many of the brightest and most advanced minds in our industry.

Today we stand for the competent implementation of the latest technologies, such as BIM – all in the spirit of efficient sustainability. In addition to the planning and realization phase, we always take into account the optimized operation of the plants and objects.

Here you get exciting backgrounds about Planovita, your life-like specialist planner for building technology!

We ask recruiters not to submit CVs. Unsolicited submissions are not considered and do not constitute a fee entitlement.

## Tâche

Quelles tâches vous attendent en tant que Project Manager Electrical Planning (h/f/d), Gisikon / Opfikon / Bern?

• Planification et mise en œuvre indépendantes de projets électriques exigeants de l'étude préliminaire au transfert au client

• Technologies de pointe et lieu de travail contemporain dans une entreprise durable

• un fonds de pension interne avec une très bonne couverture et 3 niveaux de cotisation

Si vous vous retrouvez dans cette description et que vous voulez faire partie de Planovita, nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature.

• Demande en ligne avec CV

• Appel personnel initial par téléphone, numériquement ou sur place

• Deuxième réunion et phase d ' offre

## Ce qui est important pour nous

Chez Planovita, nous apprécions et vivons la diversité. Notre processus de recrutement est donc axé sur la promotion de la diversité, de l'égalité et de l'inclusion.

## Planovita fait partie d'Implenia

En tant que premier fournisseur suisse de services immobiliers et de construction, Implenia développe, réalise et gère des espaces de vie, des environnements de travail et des infrastructures pour les générations futures en Suisse et en Allemagne. Implenia propose également des projets de tunnel et d'infrastructures connexes sur d'autres marchés. La société combine le savoir-faire d'unités hautement qualifiées de conseil, de développement, de planification et d'exécution sous un même toit en un fournisseur intégré de services de construction et d'immobilier de premier plan. Nella nostra posizione "Wohnen" a Baden, gli inquilini non solo si sentono a casa, ma sono anche gestiti in modo ottimale ed efficiente dalla nostra nuova divisione di compiti nella squadra. Questo non solo ha vantaggi per gli inquilini e la proprietà, ma anche per voi. Attraverso una maggiore specializzazione nella squadra, lavoriamo più strettamente insieme, e tutti possono concentrarsi sui loro punti di forza.

Se il tuo cuore batte per il settore immobiliare, sei motivato, orientato verso l'obiettivo e anche come lavorare in una squadra, allora non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione come

Gestione della proprietà con attività di noleggio (m/f/d)

Baden, 50 %

Questo è ciò che ti muove:

• Sarete responsabili di sostenere il team in tutte le attività amministrative all'interno del sito per garantire un funzionamento regolare

• Come primo punto di contatto sul sito, si prende il controllo del supporto clienti e sono responsabili del primo contatto con i clienti e gli inquilini

• Comunicare con l'inquilino, la manutenzione domestica, le imprese artigianali e gli uffici è uno dei vostri compiti per garantire uno scambio efficace di informazioni.

• Si prende il controllo del supporto nel processo di re-letting, dal trattamento di licenziamento al re-letting di oggetti residenziali e ausiliari.

• L'organizzazione e l'attuazione delle visite di appartamento così come la cura degli inquilini sono anche parte della vostra area di responsabilità.

• L'utente è responsabile dell'esecuzione delle dichiarazioni finali e degli insediamenti custodi, nonché dell'ottenimento e della valutazione delle offerte, dell'attribuzione di contratti alle imprese artigianali e del monitoraggio del lavoro

• La contabilità, il trattamento e l'inoltro degli ordini e delle fatture creditori, nonché il controllo e il trattamento del debitore del sistema d'esecuzione rientrano anche nella vostra area di responsabilità.

Ecco perché hai successo:

• Hai una formazione commerciale completa e preferibilmente il proprietario

• Prima esperienza professionale come impiegato: in (vantaggio nel settore immobiliare o simile) si potrebbe già raccogliere

• Siete team capace, resiliente e distinto dalla vostra personalità orientata al cliente e al servizio

• Un metodo di lavoro indipendente e orientato agli obiettivi e buone capacità di comunicazione si qualificano nel trattare con diversi gruppi di persone

• Hai una patente di guida valida

• Si comunica verbalmente e per iscritto fluentemente in tedesco, inglese di vantaggio

Ecco alcuni dei nostri vantaggi:

• Ore lavorative: Viviamo il lavoro mobile con ore di lavoro individuali (anno) e/o lavoro part-time. Fino al 40% home office è possibile. L'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una priorità assoluta per noi, perché i dipendenti equilibrati e rilassati sono importanti per noi. L'acquisto di vacanze aggiuntive è possibile.

• Mobilità e cibo: riceverete un contributo per il telefono cellulare. Per il vostro cibo, offriamo anche un contributo.

• Istruzione e formazione: promuovere i dipendenti è una parte importante della nostra cultura. Approfittate del generoso sostegno all'istruzione e alla formazione interna ed esterna. Offriamo opportunità di carriera nelle funzioni gestionali, specialistiche e di progetto

• Salär: Con noi, puoi aspettarti una remunerazione basata sul mercato con una retribuzione assoluta pari a tutti i generi. I benefici pensione sono attraenti e si può scegliere quello giusto per voi da modelli diversi. L'assicurazione contro gli infortuni copre il dipartimento ospedaliero privato.

Ulteriori informazioni sui nostri vantaggi possono essere trovate nella nostra pagina di carriera.

At our "Wohnen" location in Baden, tenants not only feel at home, but are also managed optimally and efficiently by our new division of tasks in the team. This not only has advantages for tenants and ownership, but also for you. Through more specialization in the team, we work more closely together, and everyone can focus on their strengths.

If your heart beats for real estate, you are motivated, goal-oriented and also like to work in a team, then we look forward to your application as

Property management with rental tasks (m/f/d)

Baden, 50 %

This is what moves you:

• You will be responsible for supporting the team in all administrative activities within the site to ensure a smooth operation

• As the first point of contact on site, you take over the customer support and are responsible for the first contact with customers and tenants

• Communicating with the tenant, home maintenance, craft businesses and offices is one of your tasks to ensure an effective exchange of information.

• You take over the support in the re-letting process, from the dismissal processing to the re-letting of residential and auxiliary objects.

• The organization and implementation of apartment visits as well as the care of tenants are also part of your area of responsibility.

• You are responsible for carrying out final statements and custodial settlements as well as for obtaining and assessing offers, awarding contracts to craft businesses and monitoring the work

• The accounting, processing and forwarding of creditor orders and invoices as well as the debtor control and processing of the dunning system also fall within your area of responsibility.

This is why you succeed:

• You have a completed basic commercial training and preferably the property manager

• First professional experience as a clerk: in (advantage in the real estate industry or similar) you could already collect

• You are team capable, resilient and distinguished by your customer- and service-oriented personality

• An independent and goal-oriented working method as well as good communication skills qualify you in dealing with different groups of people

• You have a valid driving license

• You communicate verbally and in writing fluently in German, English of advantage

Here are some of our benefits:

• Working hours: We live mobile work with individual (year) working hours and/or part-time work. Up to 40% home office is possible. Work-life balance is a top priority for us, because balanced and relaxed employees are important to us. The purchase of additional holidays is possible.

• Mobility and food: You will receive a contribution for the mobile phone. For your food, we also make a contribution.

• Education and training: Promoting employees is an important part of our culture. Benefit from generous support in internal and external education and training. We offer career opportunities in management, specialist and project functions

• Salär: With us, you can expect a market-based remuneration with absolute equal pay for all genders. The pension benefits are attractive and you can choose the right one for you from different models. Accident protection insurance covers the private hospital department.

More information about our benefits can be found on our career page.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com

For our department Special Foundations we are looking for you as our new Senior Project Manager Special Civil Engineering (m/f/d) 80-100%. Your future employment location will be in Opfikon.

## You move that.

• Overall responsibility for planning, controlling and implementing complex special civil engineering projects

• Management and coordination of internal and external project teams (including construction management, polishers, subcontractors)

• Ensuring compliance with deadlines, quality and costs

• Strategic AVOR, resource planning and deployment

• Contract and supplementary management incl. Negotiations with clients and partners

• Interface management to other trades and project participants

• Implementation and further development of project controlling

## This is why you succeed

• Completed training in construction (e.g. civil engineer, dipl.) Construction manager) – ideally with further training in project management

• Several years of professional experience in project management in special civil engineering

• Strong leadership skills and experience leading interdisciplinary teams

• Very good knowledge of MS Office (especially Excel), SAP/R3 and project management tools

• Entrepreneurial thinking, high personal responsibility and communication strength

• Resilient, structured and solution-oriented personality with a high level of customer orientation

## This is what we offer you

• Demanding and attractive tasks in sometimes larger projects

• A motivated team

• Varied challenges

• Innovative and sustainable working environment

• Use of modern technologies

• Support for employee development (promotion of further education by the Implenia Academy)

• Implenia-Benefits, including (to name a few):

• a company-owned pension fund with three contribution levels: Implenia Provision

• 5 weeks of vacation plus 9 bridge days

• Travel insurance for you and everyone living in your household

• Benefits for Implenia employees on products and services

Why our employees like to work for us, they tell you themselves in the following video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8

Do you share our passion for building? Become part of Implenia! We look forward to your online application stating your earliest possible start date. Is this job not interesting for you, but maybe for one of your friends or acquaintances? Then forward the ad with the “Share” function at the foot of the page. Thank you very much.

*We ask recruiters not to submit unsolicited CVs. All submissions are not considered and do not constitute an obligation.

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore focused on promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

Ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen, ein Auge fürs Detail und den Blick fürs grosse Ganze: Damit unterstützt du unsere Projekte dabei, auch kaufmännisch erfolgreich zu sein.

## Aufgaben

Welche Aufgaben erwarten dich als Kaufmännischer Projektmitarbeiter bilingual (m/w/d) Opfikon (Zürich) oder Onex-Genève?

• Mit deiner bilingualen Kompetenz unterstützt du die Regional- und Projektleitung bei organisatorischen sowie administrativen Projektaufgaben in Deutsch und Französisch.

• Du erstellst Abrechnungsgrundlagen inklusive der erforderlichen Dokumentation, bereitest Nachträge auf und verfolgst deren weitere Bearbeitung konsequent nach.

• Die Erstellung von Ausgangsrechnungen sowie die konsequente Nachverfolgung der Zahlungseingänge gehören zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich.

• Du prüfst die Eingangsrechnungen und schreibst bei Bedarf Rechnungsrückweisungen.

• Im Controlling unterstützt du die kaufmännische Projektleitung bei projektbezogenen Auswertungen, Reportings und weiteren Controllingaufgaben.

descriptionByLocale.en:
For our region of Zurich, the unit "New Construction - Special Projects" within the division "Buildings", we are looking for reinforcement in the project management. Your place of work will be our headquarters «Connect» in Opfikon.

In our new construction unit special projects we realize challenging industrial and large-scale construction projects in the Zurich region. The projects operate in a complex environment with high technical requirements, demanding approval procedures and diverse interfaces to authorities, planners and building owners.

Do you have experience in managing new construction projects and are enthusiastic about demanding industrial and special construction projects? We look forward to your application.

## Tasks

Which tasks await you as Project Manager GU/TU Special Projects (m/f/d)?

• Responsibility for the economic achievement of new construction projects in the Zurich region – from the start of implementation to the turnkey handover – in compliance with quality, deadlines and costs

• Responsible operational project management taking into account all safety, timing and qualitative requirements

• Active management of subcontractors, suppliers and specialist planners

• Leadership of the execution team, composed of construction managers and other specialists

• Main contact for builders, business partners and authorities incl. Ensuring transparent communication and seamless documentation

## Requirements

What requirements do you bring as Project Manager GU/TU Special Projects (m/f/d)?

• Completed basic technical training with further training in construction or project management (e.g. technician:in HF, construction manager:in, project manager:in) or completed studies in architecture, civil engineering or a similar specialisation (FH/ETH/University)

• In-depth practical experience in construction management as well as 2 to 5 years of experience in the management and control of demanding new construction projects in the TU/GU or construction management environment

• Entrepreneurial thinking, assertiveness and strong social skills

• Experience as a general contractor, preferably in an international environment

• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

## Benefits

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• Flexible working models with up to 40% home office

• Excellent travel insurance for you and those living in the same household

• An exciting selection of benefits:

• 5 weeks of vacation (6 weeks from age 50) and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

Why our employees like to work for us, they tell you themselves in the following video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8.

## What is the application process at Implenia?

At Implenia, you can expect a simple and transparent application process:

• Online application with CV

• Personal initial call by telephone, digitally or on site

• Second meeting and offer phase

## What else is important to us

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore aimed at promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

## About Implenia

As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com.

*We ask recruiters not to submit unsolicited CVs. All submissions are not considered and do not constitute an obligation.

• Auf Baustellen übernimmst du Kontrollgänge und führst Qualitätsprüfungen durch.

• Du berätst und begleitest Planerinnen, Planer sowie weitere Projektbeteiligte bei bauphysikalischen und nachhaltigkeitsbezogenen Anforderungen.

• Bei Neu- und Bestandsbauprojekten verantwortest du Themen wie thermische Behaglichkeit, Feuchteschutz, Luftdichtigkeit, Tageslicht und optional Bauakustik.

• Du führst Nachhaltigkeitszertifizierungen wie SNBS, Minergie, Minergie-ECO, DGNB, LEED, WELL oder BREEAM durch und begleitest den gesamten Prozess.

• Dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung teilst du gerne mit weniger erfahrenen Teammitgliedern.

• In der Zusammenarbeit mit hochqualifizierten Fachpersonen entwickelst du deine eigenen Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiter.

Welche Anforderungen bringst du als Projektleiter Bauphysik & Nachhaltigkeit (m/w/d) mit?

• Du verfügst über eine relevante Ausbildung oder ein Studium, beispielsweise in Bauingenieurwesen oder Bauphysik. Eine Weiterbildung im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit ist von Vorteil.

• Unsere Begeisterung für eine nachhaltige Bauwirtschaft teilst du und arbeitest dich gerne vertieft in neue fachliche Themen ein.

• Die Zusammenarbeit im Team ist dir wichtig und du stellst den gemeinsamen Projekterfolg in den Mittelpunkt.

## Benefits

• Ein multikulturelles Arbeitsumfeld mit der Chance, eine lebenswerte Zukunft mitzugestalten

• Modernste Technologien und einen zeitgemässen Arbeitsplatz bei einem nachhaltigen Unternehmen

• Ein Unternehmen, das Talente und die Weiterbildung seiner Mitarbeitenden fördert

• Die Sicherheit eines finanziell gesunden, breit aufgestellten Konzerns mit starken Wurzeln in der Schweiz

• Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit bis zu 40% Homeoffice

• Eine hervorragende Reiseversicherung für dich und im gleichen Haushalt lebende Personen

• Eine spannende Auswahl an Benefits:

• 5 Wochen Ferien (6 Wochen ab dem 50. Lebensjahr) und 9 bezahlte Brückentage

• eine hauseigene Pensionskasse mit sehr gutem Deckungsgrad und 3 Beitragsstufen

• zahlreiche Preisnachlässe auf namhafte Anbieter von Produkt- und Dienstleistungen

## Wie läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei Encira ab?

Bei Encira erwartet dich ein einfacher und transparenter Bewerbungsprozess:

• Online-Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf

• Persönliches Erstgespräch per Telefon, digital oder vor Ort

• Zweitgespräch und Angebotsphase

## Was uns noch wichtig ist

Bei Encira schätzen und leben wir Diversität. Unser Rekrutierungsprozess ist daher auf die Förderung von Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion ausgerichtet.

## Encira ist Teil von Implenia

Encira ist das Planungs- und Beratungsunternehmen der Implenia-Gruppe für Akustik, Bauphysik, Nachhaltigkeit und Energie. Wir begleiten Bauprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zur Realisierung und entwickeln praxisnahe Lösungen für Bauherrschaften, Architekten und Planerteams. Weitere Informationen unter encira.ch .

Als führender Schweizer Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister entwickelt, realisiert und bewirtschaftet Implenia Lebensräume, Arbeitswelten und Infrastruktur für künftige Generationen in der Schweiz und in Deutschland. Zudem bietet Implenia in weiteren Märkten Tunnelbau- und damit verbundene Infrastrukturprojekte. Das Unternehmen fasst das Know-how aus hochqualifizierten Beratungs-, Entwicklungs-, Planungs- und Ausführungseinheiten unter einem Dach zu einem integrierten, multinational führenden Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister zusammen. Mit Hauptsitz in Opfikon bei Zürich beschäftigt Implenia europaweit über 8 000 Mitarbeitende (FTE) und erzielte im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 3,5 Mrd. Weitere Informationen unter implenia .com.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stai cercando più del prossimo progetto? Con noi, si assume la responsabilità per la gestione dei costi di complessi progetti di costruzione e infrastrutture e garantire una gestione dei costi trasparente, predittivo e resiliente in tutte le fasi del progetto. Con la tua comprensione commerciale, supporta la gestione del progetto in decisioni importanti e contribuisce in modo significativo al successo del progetto.

## Compiti

Quali compiti vi attendono come Senior Cost Manager Data Center (m/f/d)?

• Responsabilità complessiva per la pianificazione dei costi di costruzione, il bilancio e la previsione di progetti di data center esigenti.

• Analisi degli sviluppi dei costi, dei rischi e delle opportunità, nonché dello sviluppo di solide basi decisionali per la gestione dei progetti.

• Gestione dei processi di aggiudicazione e di aggiudicazione, compresa la valutazione delle offerte, i negoziati contrattuali e le raccomandazioni di aggiudicazione.

• Assicurare un controllo trasparente dei costi monitorando budget, impegni, modifiche e previsioni.

• Valutazione commerciale di addenda e cambiamenti di progetto e supporto per la gestione dei cambiamenti.

• Condurre analisi di costi, mercato e benchmark per identificare il potenziale di ottimizzazione e risparmio.

• Ulteriore sviluppo di standard di gestione dei costi, processi e strumenti, nonché supporto tecnico e coordinamento all'interno del team di progetto.

## Requisiti

Quali sono quelli che porti come Senior Cost Manager Data Center (m/f/d)?

• Studi completi in ingegneria civile, ingegneria industriale, sondaggio quantitativo, gestione del progetto, tecnologia di costruzione o una formazione comparabile.

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione dei costi, nella pianificazione dei costi di calcolo/costruzione, nell'indagine sulle quantità o nella gestione delle costruzioni/gestione dei progetti

• Conoscenza approfondita della pianificazione dei costi, delle previsioni, dell'offerta, dell'approvvigionamento e della contrazione commerciale.

• Esperienza nella gestione del cambiamento, del reclamo o del contratto, nonché nella gestione dei costi e degli strumenti di reporting.

• Idealmente, l'esperienza in complessi progetti di costruzione, infrastruttura, industriale o data center.

• Forte capacità di pensiero analitico, alta affinità per i numeri e una forte consapevolezza dei costi e dei rischi.

• Metodi di lavoro indipendenti e strutturati combinati con capacità di comunicazione convincenti e di negoziazione.

• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese

## Vantaggi

Quali vantaggi offriamo come Senior Cost Manager Data Center (m/f/d)?

•

• Un ambiente di lavoro multiculturale con la possibilità di plasmare un futuro degno di vivere

• Tecnologie all'avanguardia e un luogo di lavoro contemporaneo in un'azienda sostenibile

• Una società che promuove il talento e la formazione dei propri dipendenti

• La sicurezza di un gruppo finanziariamente sano con radici forti in Svizzera

• Modelli di lavoro flessibili con fino al 40% ufficio domestico

• Eccellente assicurazione di viaggio per voi e coloro che vivono nella stessa famiglia

• Una selezione emozionante di vantaggi

• 5 settimane di vacanza (6 settimane dall'età 50) e 9 giorni di ponte pagati

• un fondo pensione interno con una copertura molto buona e 3 livelli di contributo

• numerosi sconti sui noti fornitori di prodotti e servizi

## Qual è il processo di applicazione a Implenia?

A Implenia, puoi aspettarti un processo di applicazione semplice e trasparente:

• Applicazione online con CV

• Chiamata iniziale personale per telefono, digitalmente o sul sito

• Seconda riunione e fase di offerta

## Che altro è importante per noi

A Implenia, apprezziamo e viviamo la diversità. Il nostro processo di selezione mira quindi a promuovere la diversità, l'uguaglianza e l'inclusione. Le applicazioni da persone con disabilità sono espressamente benvenuti.

## Informazioni su Implenia

Come fornitore leader di servizi edili e immobiliari svizzeri, Implenia sviluppa, realizza e gestisce spazi abitativi, ambienti di lavoro e infrastrutture per le generazioni future in Svizzera e in Germania. Implenia offre anche progetti di tunnelling e infrastrutture correlate in altri mercati. L'azienda combina il know-how di unità di consulenza, sviluppo, pianificazione e esecuzione altamente qualificate sotto un tetto in un fornitore di servizi di costruzione e immobiliare leader internazionale e impiega circa 9.000 persone in tutta Europa.

Chiediamo ai reclutatori di non presentare i CV. Le richieste non richieste non sono considerate e non costituiscono un diritto a pagamento.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you looking for more than the next project? With us, you take responsibility for the cost management of complex construction and infrastructure projects and ensure transparent, predictive and resilient cost management throughout all project phases. With your commercial understanding, you support project management in important decisions and contribute significantly to project success.

## Tasks

What tasks await you as Senior Cost Manager Data Center (m/f/d)?

• Overall responsibility for construction cost planning, budgeting and forecasting of demanding data center projects.

• Analysis of cost developments, risks and opportunities as well as the development of sound decision-making bases for project management.

• Management of tendering and awarding processes, including tender evaluation, contract negotiations and award recommendations.

• Ensure transparent cost controlling by monitoring budgets, commitments, changes and forecasts.

• Commercial evaluation of addenda and project changes as well as support for change management.

• Conduct cost, market and benchmark analyses to identify potential for optimisation and savings.

• Further development of cost management standards, processes and tools as well as technical support and coordination within the project team.

## Requirements

Which ones do you bring as Senior Cost Manager Data Center (m/f/d)?

• Completed studies in civil engineering, industrial engineering, quantity surveying, project management, building technology or a comparable education.

• Several years of professional experience in cost management, calculation/construction cost planning, quantity surveying or in construction management/project management

• In-depth knowledge in cost planning, forecasting, tendering, procurement and commercial contracting.

• Experience in change, claim or contract management as well as in dealing with cost management and reporting tools.

• Ideally, experience in complex construction, infrastructure, industrial or data center projects.

• Strong analytical thinking skills, high affinity for numbers and a strong awareness of costs and risks.

• Independent and structured working methods combined with convincing communication and negotiation skills.

• Very good knowledge of German and English

## Benefits

What benefits do we offer you as Senior Cost Manager Data Center (m/f/d)?

•

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• Flexible working models with up to 40% home office

• Excellent travel insurance for you and those living in the same household

• An exciting selection of benefits

• 5 weeks of vacation (6 weeks from age 50) and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

## What is the application process at Implenia?

At Implenia, you can expect a simple and transparent application process:

• Online application with CV

• Personal initial call by telephone, digitally or on site

• Second meeting and offer phase

## What else is important to us

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our selection process is therefore aimed at promoting diversity, equality and inclusion. Applications from people with disabilities are expressly welcome.

## About Implenia

As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider and employs around 9,000 people throughout Europe.

We ask recruiters not to submit CVs. Unsolicited submissions are not considered and do not constitute a fee entitlement.

Il team di progetto implementa un rinomato progetto su larga scala da un rinomato proprietario di un edificio ed è accompagnato da un noto ufficio architettonico. Il team è composto da circa 15 persone dai campi di esecuzione, pianificazione, finanza e amministrazione. L'ambizioso team ha un buon spirito, si alza l'uno per l'altro e apprezza il trattamento onesto l'altro.

Diventa parte di noi e continua a svilupparsi!

• Responsabilità per raggiungere gli obiettivi economici dei progetti di conversione nella regione di Zurigo – dall'offerta alla messa in servizio – in conformità con qualità, scadenze e costi

• Gestione dei progetti operativi responsabile tenendo conto di tutte le esigenze di sicurezza, tempistica e qualitativa

• Cooperazione stretta con subappaltatori, fornitori, pianificatori e autorità

• Contatto per costruttori, partner commerciali e altri stakeholder

• Una società che promuove il talento e la formazione dei propri dipendenti

• La sicurezza di un gruppo finanziariamente sano con radici forti in Svizzera

• 5 settimane di vacanza (6 settimane dall'età 50) e 9 giorni di ponte pagati

• un fondo pensione interno con una copertura molto buona e 3 livelli di contributo

A Implenia, apprezziamo e viviamo la diversità. Il nostro processo di reclutamento mira quindi a promuovere la diversità, l'uguaglianza e l'inclusione.

Come fornitore leader di servizi edili e immobiliari svizzeri, Implenia sviluppa, realizza e gestisce spazi abitativi, ambienti di lavoro e infrastrutture per le generazioni future in Svizzera e in Germania. Implenia offre anche progetti di tunnelling e infrastrutture correlate in altri mercati. L'azienda combina il know-how di unità di consulenza, sviluppo, pianificazione e esecuzione altamente qualificate sotto un tetto in un fornitore di servizi di costruzione e immobiliare integrato, multinazionale leader. descriptionByLocale.en:
For our conversion team in the Zurich region, we are looking for a motivated project manager (m/f/d). Place of employment for the job is our headquarters in Opfikon. Your place of work will be the building office in the heart of the city of Zurich.

The project team implements a renowned large-scale project by a renowned building owner and is accompanied by a well-known architectural office. The team consists of around 15 people from the fields of execution, planning, finance and administration. The ambitious team has a good spirit, stands up for each other and appreciates the honest treatment of each other.

Become a part of us and continue to develop!

## Tasks

What tasks await you as a project manager conversion (m/f/d)?

• Responsibility for achieving the economic goals of conversion projects in the Zurich region – from tendering to commissioning – in compliance with quality, deadlines and costs

• Responsible operational project management taking into account all safety, timing and qualitative requirements

• Close cooperation with subcontractors, suppliers, planners and authorities

• Contact for builders, business partners and other stakeholders

• Professional guidance and promotion of the construction managers in your team

• Ensuring transparent communication and seamless documentation

• Regular reporting to the overall project manager

## Requirements

What requirements do you bring with you as project manager conversion (m/f/d)?

• Completed training as project manager:in, technician:in TS, architect:in or civil engineer:in

• 2–5 years of experience in managing renovation projects

• Independent management of complex construction sites

• Experience in the professional management of up to five construction managers

• Entrepreneurial mindset, assertiveness and high social skills

• Familiarity with the general contractor environment

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing

## Benefits

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• Flexible working models with up to 40% home office

• Excellent travel insurance for you and those living in the same household

• An exciting selection of benefits:

• 5 weeks of vacation (6 weeks from age 50) and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

Why our employees like to work for us, they tell you themselves in the following video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8.

## What is the application process at Implenia?

At Implenia, you can expect a simple and transparent application process:

• Online application with CV

• Personal initial call by telephone, digitally or on site

• Second meeting and offer phase

## What else is important to us

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore aimed at promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

## About Implenia

As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com.

*We ask recruiters not to submit unsolicited CVs. All submissions are not considered and do not constitute an obligation.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com

For our Zurich conversion department we are looking for you as a polisher: in pollution remediation. Your field of application includes varied construction sites in the Zurich region. You work in a dynamic, uncomplicated team, which convinces with a healthy mixture of experience and fresh wind. You expect a strong team spirit and a lot of personal responsibility.

## You move that

• Management of the construction sites in cooperation with the project manager

• Professional guidance and instruction of site workers as well as clean and continuous communication with the foremen

• Plan, prepare and execute:

• On-site inspections

• Preparation of the required documents for the authorities and the foremen (e.g. SUVA, UGZ, STEB, cantons, municipality): forms, plans, restructuring concepts

• Site visit with foremen before the start of the order

• Check before work starts in the black area (according to EKAS 6503)

• Final inspection before clearance

• Assistance in carrying out all rehabilitation work

• Enforcement of occupational safety

• Enforcement and compliance with all SUVA guidelines for the protection of employees (EKAS 6503/6508), in particular the “red points list of SUVA”

• Active cooperation to improve processes and construction site processes, work, use of materials and the like

• Correct and friendly behavior at the customer / on the construction site

• Preparation of polishing dimensions

• Directing

• Aid for supplementary management

• Preparation of small quotes

## This is why you succeed

• Ideally, you already have experience in pollutant remediation, or you want to develop specifically in this area.

• You work structured, organized and exact – even if it gets hectic.

• With your entrepreneurial mindset and negotiation skills, you are always looking for win-win solutions for the customer and the company.

• You are resilient, show a high level of commitment and keep an overview even in complex projects.

• The handling of MS Office is easy for you and you communicate safely in German – other languages are a plus.

• You are a real team player with a customer-oriented mindset and actively participate in the joint success.

## This is what we offer you

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living in

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• An exciting selection of benefits:

• 5 weeks holidays and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

Why our employees like to work for us, they tell you themselves in the following video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8

Could you be interested in this job? If so, apply for this listing today! We look forward to meeting you.

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore aimed at promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

*We ask recruiters not to submit unsolicited CVs. All submissions are not considered and do not constitute an obligation.

Als führender Schweizer Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister entwickelt, realisiert und bewirtschaftet Implenia Lebensräume, Arbeitswelten und Infrastruktur für künftige Generationen in der Schweiz und in Deutschland. As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com

We are looking for a project manager: in execution GU/TU for our office in Gisikon. With us, you can expect exciting projects ranging from business and residential buildings to wooden high-rise buildings to industrial buildings and we offer you a modern working environment. In addition, lean principles as well as BIM are not only theory for us, but are implemented comprehensively and consistently in our projects. 20 years after its founding, Implenia is now optimally positioned and ready for a successful future.

## You move that

• As a project manager: in GU/TU you achieve the economic project goals of new construction projects in compliance with the specified quality, deadlines and costs from the tender to the commissioning.

• You manage your projects operationally and under your own responsibility, taking into account the safety, timing, qualitative and quantitative requirements

• You work with local subcontractors, suppliers, planners and authorities

• In your role as project manager: you are the contact person for builders, business partners and tenants

• You coordinate the specialist planners in your project and ensure the overall coordination of the planning

• In addition, you are responsible for the further education of the construction managers: inside your team

• You maintain an open and respectful communication culture as well as a clean documentation and report the current status of the projects to your team leader:

## This is why you succeed

• Completed training as project manager:in, technician:in TS, architect:in or civil engineer:in

• 2 - 5 years of experience as project manager: in new construction or conversion projects

• Independent management of construction sites with high complexity

• Technical guidance of up to five construction managers: inside

• You have very good knowledge of German in word and writing

• Entrepreneurial and purposeful thinking

• Enforcement and high social skills

• Familiarity with general contractor environment

## This is what we offer you

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• An exciting selection of benefits:

• 5 weeks holidays and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

• Erstellung von Gebäudeanalysen in Bezug auf die Gebäudetechnik

• Projektierung, Devisierung und Ausführungsplanung von Projekten im Bereich Heizung

• Pflegen des Kundennetzwerks und aktive Akquise neuer Aufträge

## Anforderungen

Welche Anforderungen bringst du mit als Projektleiter Heizung (m/w/d), Gisikon, 80-100%?

• Ausbildung als Gebäudetechnikplaner, Techniker:in HF/TS oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer adäquaten Position

• Erfahrung in der Planung und Realisierung von Heizungsprojekten

• Gute Kenntnisse in MS-Office, sowie CAD (Nova), idealerweise Erfahrung mit BIM

• Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

• Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Projektbeteiligten

## Benefits

• Ein multikulturelles Arbeitsumfeld mit der Chance, eine lebenswerte Zukunft mitzugestalten

• Modernste Technologien und einen zeitgemässen Arbeitsplatz bei einem nachhaltigen Unternehmen

• Ein Unternehmen, das Talente und die Weiterbildung seiner Mitarbeitenden fördert

• Die Sicherheit eines finanziell gesunden, breit aufgestellten Konzerns mit starken Wurzeln in der Schweiz

• Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit bis zu 40% Homeoffice

• Eine hervorragende Reiseversicherung für dich und im gleichen Haushalt lebende Personen

• Eine spannende Auswahl an Benefits:

• 5 Wochen Ferien (6 Wochen ab dem 50. Lebensjahr) und 9 bezahlte Brückentage

• eine hauseigene Pensionskasse mit sehr gutem Deckungsgrad und 3 Beitragsstufen

• zahlreiche Preisnachlässe auf namhafte Anbieter von Produkt- und Dienstleistungen

Wenn Du dich in dieser Beschreibung wiederfindest und Teil von Planovita werden möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

## Wie läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei Planovita ab?

Bei Plaovita erwartet dich ein einfacher und transparenter Bewerbungsprozess:

• Online-Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf

• Persönliches Erstgespräch per Telefon, digital oder vor Ort

• Zweitgespräch und Angebotsphase

## Was uns noch wichtig ist

Bei Planovita schätzen und leben wir Diversität. Unser Rekrutierungsprozess ist daher auf die Förderung von Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion ausgerichtet.

## Planovita ist Teil von Implenia

Als führender Schweizer Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister entwickelt, realisiert und bewirtschaftet Implenia Lebensräume, Arbeitswelten und Infrastruktur für künftige Generationen in der Schweiz und in Deutschland. Zudem bietet Implenia in weiteren Märkten Tunnelbau- und damit verbundene Infrastrukturprojekte. Das Unternehmen fasst das Know-how aus hochqualifizierten Beratungs-, Entwicklungs-, Planungs- und Ausführungseinheiten unter einem Dach zu einem integrierten, multinational führenden Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister zusammen. Mit Hauptsitz in Opfikon bei Zürich beschäftigt Implenia europaweit über 8 000 Mitarbeitende (FTE) und erzielte im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 3,5 Mrd. Weitere Informationen unter implenia .com.

Herzlich willkommen bei Planovita!

Wir füllen Gebäudetechnikplanung mit Leben – smart, effizient, nachhaltig!

Unser heutiges Unternehmen mit seinen rund 30 Mitarbeitenden kann auf eine vieljährige, bewegte Geschichte zurückblicken. Wobei Rückblicke eigentlich nicht unser Ding sind – wir sehen lieber nach vorne! Hierfür haben wir viele der klügsten und fortschrittlichsten Köpfe unserer Branche gewinnen können.

Heute stehen wir für die kompetente Implementierung neuester Technologien , wie etwa BIM – alles im Geist der effizienten Nachhaltigkeit. Neben der Planungs- und Realisierungsphase berücksichtigen wir immer auch den optimierten Betrieb der Anlagen und Objekte .

Hier erhältst du spannende Hintergründe zu Planovita, deinem lebensnahen Fachplaner für Gebäudetechnik!

Chez Plaovita, vous pouvez vous attendre à un processus de demande simple et transparent:

En tant que premier fournisseur suisse de services immobiliers et de construction, Implenia développe, réalise et gère des espaces de vie, des environnements de travail et des infrastructures pour les générations futures en Suisse et en Allemagne. Par où les rétrospectives ne sont pas notre chose – nous préférons regarder vers l'avenir! Nous avons gagné beaucoup des esprits les plus brillants et les plus avancés de notre industrie.

With our many years of experience, high technical competence and a strong interdisciplinary team, we realize demanding timber construction services across all phases – from planning to production to execution.

In order to further develop our organization and shape timber construction in a future-oriented way, we are looking for committed personalities who want to take responsibility and grow together with us – as a calculator (senior, junior) (m/f/d).

Do you have what it takes to turn your communication skills and entrepreneurial thinking into attractive offers? Are analytical, timely and independent work just as important to you as your excellent skills as a team player? Then we are very much looking forward to your commitment for our team in Rümlang!

## These tasks await you:

• Responsible preparation of calculations and supplementary offers

• Independent development of the submission processes until input incl. Coordination of subcontractor requests

• Development of embodiment variants and economic calculations

• Preparation and monitoring of contract negotiations

• Independent acquisition of new orders for element production

• Preparation and maintenance of calculation key figures based on post-calculations

## We want this education and experience from you:

• Apprenticeship as carpenter and polisher training or technician HF

• Sound knowledge of timber construction

• Professional experience in the execution of timber construction projects, ideally already as a calculator / builder / project manager

• Challenging and attractive tasks in larger projects

• A motivated team

• Varied challenges

• Innovative and sustainable working environment

• Support for employee development (promotion of further education by the Implenia Academy)

• Implenia-Benefits, including (to name a few):

• a company-owned pension fund with three contribution levels: Implenia Provision

• Travel insurance for you and everyone living in your household

jobs.description:
Als führender Schweizer Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister entwickelt, realisiert und bewirtschaftet Implenia Lebensräume, Arbeitswelten und Infrastruktur für künftige Generationen in der Schweiz und in Deutschland. Zudem bietet Implenia in weiteren Märkten Tunnelbau- und damit verbundene Infrastrukturprojekte. Das Unternehmen fasst das Know-how aus hochqualifizierten Beratungs-, Entwicklungs-, Planungs- und Ausführungseinheiten unter einem Dach zu einem integrierten, multinational führenden Bau- und Immobiliendienstleister zusammen. Mit Hauptsitz in Opfikon bei Zürich beschäftigt Implenia europaweit über 8 000 Mitarbeitende (FTE) und erzielte im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 3,5 Mrd. Weitere Informationen unter implenia.com

Für unseren Baumeisterstandort in Gisikon (Geschäftsstelle Luzern) suchen wir dich als Projektleiter:in Baumeister (w/m/d) . Dein Einsatzgebiet erstreckt sich über die Zentralschweiz , wo du anspruchsvolle Hochbauprojekte vom Baubeginn bis zur Übergabe verantwortest.

Am Standort Gisikon bietet Implenia das gesamte Leistungsportfolio im Hochbau: von der AVOR über die Ausführung bis zur Bauvollendung komplexer Neubau- und Modernisierungsprojekte. Dabei setzen wir konsequent auf digitale Prozesse: Kalkulation, Ausmass und Nachtragsofferten laufen über BauBit pro, BIM-Modelle und Pläne teilen wir mit allen Projektbeteiligten über Trimble Connect, und Lieferscheine werden papierlos über Comstruct abgewickelt. Du arbeitest in einem erfahrenen, interdisziplinären Team, das den Anspruch hat, anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte mit modernen Werkzeugen effizient umzusetzen.

## Das bewegst du

• Führen und Realisieren von anspruchsvollen Hochbauten

• Kaufmännische und technische Leitung des Projekts

• Führen der Bauführer:innen

• Selbstständige Ausarbeitung und Durchsetzung von Nachtragsofferten

• Ressourcenplanung und Überwachung des Vertragsmanagements

## Deshalb gelingt es dir

• Abschluss als dipl. Bauingenieur FH, dipl. Baumeister oder dipl. Bauführer TS

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Projektleitung in einer Bauunternehmung

• Erfahrung mit schweizerischen Normen und im Bauvertragswesen

• Unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln

• Durchsetzungsvermögen und Enthusiasmus für das Bauen

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

## Das bieten wir dir

• Spannende Grossprojekte

• Ein multikulturelles Arbeitsumfeld mit der Chance, eine lebenswerte Zukunft mitzugestalten

• Modernste Technologien und einen zeitgemässen Arbeitsplatz bei einem nachhaltigen Unternehmen

• Ein Unternehmen, das Talente und die Weiterbildung seiner Mitarbeitenden fördert

• Die Sicherheit eines finanziell gesunden, breit aufgestellten Konzerns mit starken Wurzeln in der Schweiz

• Eine spannende Auswahl an Benefits:

• 5 Wochen Ferien und 9 bezahlte Brückentage

• eine hauseigene Pensionskasse mit sehr gutem Deckungsgrad und 3 Beitragsstufen

• zahlreiche Preisnachlässe auf namhafte Anbieter von Produkt- und Dienstleistungen

Wieso unsere Mitarbeitenden gerne bei uns arbeiten, sagen sie dir gleich selbst in folgendem Video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8

Könnte dich diese Stelle interessieren? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über unser Karriereportal. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Bei Implenia schätzen und leben wir Diversität. Unser Rekrutierungsprozess ist daher auf die Förderung von Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion ausgerichtet.

*Wir bitten die Personalvermittler, keine unaufgeforderten Lebensläufe einzureichen. Alle Einsendungen werden nicht berücksichtigt und stellen keine Verpflichtung dar.

## Fragen?

Martina Popovic, Talent Acquisition Partner Division Buildings, beantwortet dir gerne deine Fragen per E-Mail: martina.popovic@implenia.com .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come fornitore leader di servizi edili e immobiliari svizzeri, Implenia sviluppa, realizza e gestisce spazi abitativi, ambienti di lavoro e infrastrutture per le generazioni future in Svizzera e in Germania. Implenia offre anche progetti di tunnelling e infrastrutture correlate in altri mercati. L'azienda combina il know-how di unità di consulenza, sviluppo, pianificazione e esecuzione altamente qualificate sotto un tetto in un fornitore di servizi di costruzione e immobiliare integrato, multinazionale leader. Con sede a Opfikon vicino a Zurigo, Implenia impiega oltre 8.000 persone (FTE) in tutta Europa e ha raggiunto un fatturato di 3,5 miliardi di franchi nel 2025. Maggiori informazioni su implenia.com

Per la nostra posizione di Baumeister a Gisikon (ufficio Lucerne) ti stiamo cercando come project manager: in Baumeister (m/f/d). Il vostro campo di applicazione si estende in tutta la Svizzera centrale, dove siete responsabili di impegnativi progetti di costruzione dall'inizio della costruzione alla consegna.

Nel sito di Gisikon, Implenia offre l'intero portafoglio di servizi nella costruzione di edifici: da AVOR all'esecuzione e al completamento di complessi nuovi progetti di costruzione e modernizzazione. In questo modo, ci concentriamo costantemente sui processi digitali: il calcolo, la portata e le offerte aggiuntive eseguite tramite BauBit pro, i modelli BIM e i piani sono condivisi con tutti i partecipanti al progetto tramite Trimble Connect, e le note di consegna vengono gestite senza carta tramite Comstruct. Potrai lavorare in un team esperto e interdisciplinare che mira a implementare in modo efficiente progetti di costruzione impegnativi con strumenti moderni.

## Muovetevi.

• Gestione e realizzazione di edifici esigenti

• Gestione commerciale e tecnica del progetto

• Guidare i costruttori: dentro

• Preparazione e applicazione indipendenti delle offerte complementari

• Pianificazione delle risorse e monitoraggio della gestione dei contratti

## Ecco perché hai successo

• Complezione come dipl. Ingegnere civile FH, dipl. Baumeister o dipl. Responsabile della costruzione TS

• Diversi anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti in una società di costruzione

• Esperienza con gli standard svizzeri e nei contratti di costruzione

• pensiero e azione imprenditoriali

• Impegno ed entusiasmo per la costruzione

• Conoscenza negoziabile del tedesco nella parola e nella scrittura

## Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Progetti importanti

• Un ambiente di lavoro multiculturale con la possibilità di plasmare un futuro degno di vivere

• Tecnologie all'avanguardia e un luogo di lavoro contemporaneo in un'azienda sostenibile

• Una società che promuove il talento e la formazione dei propri dipendenti

• La sicurezza di un gruppo finanziariamente sano con radici forti in Svizzera

• Una selezione emozionante di vantaggi:

• 5 settimane vacanze e 9 giorni di ponte pagati

• un fondo pensione interno con una copertura molto buona e 3 livelli di contributo

• numerosi sconti sui noti fornitori di prodotti e servizi

Perché i nostri dipendenti amano lavorare per noi, si raccontano nel seguente video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8

Potrebbe interessarti a questo lavoro? Quindi non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione tramite il nostro portale di carriera. Non vediamo l'ora di incontrarti.

A Implenia, apprezziamo e viviamo la diversità. Il nostro processo di reclutamento mira quindi a promuovere la diversità, l'uguaglianza e l'inclusione.

*Chiediamo ai reclutatori di non presentare CV non richiesti. Tutte le conclusioni non sono considerate e non costituiscono un obbligo.

## Domande?

Martina Popovic, Talent Acquisition Partner Division Buildings, è lieta di rispondere alle vostre domande via email: martina.popovic@implenia.com.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a leading Swiss construction and real estate service provider, Implenia develops, realizes and manages living spaces, working environments and infrastructure for future generations in Switzerland and Germany. Implenia also offers tunnelling and related infrastructure projects in other markets. The company combines the know-how of highly qualified consulting, development, planning and execution units under one roof into an integrated, multinationally leading construction and real estate service provider. Headquartered in Opfikon near Zurich, Implenia employs more than 8,000 people (FTE) across Europe and achieved a turnover of CHF 3.5 billion in 2025. More information at implenia.com

For our Baumeister location in Gisikon (Lucerne office) we are looking for you as project manager: in Baumeister (m/f/d). Your field of application extends across Central Switzerland, where you are responsible for challenging building construction projects from the start of construction to the handover.

At the Gisikon site, Implenia offers the entire portfolio of services in building construction: from AVOR to execution and completion of complex new construction and modernization projects. In doing so, we consistently focus on digital processes: calculation, extent and supplementary offers run via BauBit pro, BIM models and plans are shared with all project participants via Trimble Connect, and delivery notes are handled paperlessly via Comstruct. You will work in an experienced, interdisciplinary team that aims to efficiently implement challenging construction projects with modern tools.

## You move that

• Management and implementation of demanding buildings

• Commercial and technical management of the project

• Leading the builders: inside

• Independent preparation and enforcement of supplementary offers

• Resource planning and monitoring of contract management

## This is why you succeed

• Completion as a dipl. Civil engineer FH, dipl. Baumeister or dipl. Construction manager TS

• Several years of experience in project management in a construction company

• Experience with Swiss standards and in building contracts

• Entrepreneurial thinking and action

• Commitment and enthusiasm for building

• Negotiable knowledge of German in word and writing

## This is what we offer you

• Exciting major projects

• A multicultural working environment with the chance to shape a future worth living

• State-of-the-art technologies and a contemporary workplace at a sustainable company

• A company that promotes talent and the training of its employees

• The security of a financially healthy, broad-based group with strong roots in Switzerland

• An exciting selection of benefits:

• 5 weeks holidays and 9 paid bridge days

• an in-house pension fund with very good coverage and 3 contribution levels

• numerous discounts on well-known suppliers of products and services

Why our employees like to work for us, they tell you themselves in the following video: https://youtu.be/wtuhlIfjJq8

Could you be interested in this job? Then we look forward to your application via our career portal. We look forward to meeting you.

At Implenia, we value and live diversity. Our recruitment process is therefore aimed at promoting diversity, equality and inclusion.

*We ask recruiters not to submit unsolicited CVs. All submissions are not considered and do not constitute an obligation.

## Questions?

Martina Popovic, Talent Acquisition Partner Division Buildings, is happy to answer your questions by email: martina.popovic@implenia.com.
